CSIR-National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR-NAL), Bengaluru, has released the CSIR-NAL Technician-1 final result 2026 for candidates who applied under Advertisement No. 05/2025. Published on the official CSIR-NAL career page on 28 August 2026, this update covers the disposal of candidate representations along with the final list of provisionally shortlisted and not-shortlisted applicants issued separately for each Technician-1 post code (T-101, T-102, T-103, T-104, T-105, T-106, T-109, and T-114). If you applied for any of these post codes, this article gives you direct, post-code-wise PDF links to check your status, along with everything officially confirmed so far about this notification.

How to Check Your CSIR-NAL Technician-1 Result

  1. Visit the official CSIR-NAL career page at nal.res.in/en/career.
  2. Locate your post code (T-101 to T-114, as applicable) in the listing table.
  3. Click the PDF link next to your post code's entry under "Documents."
  4. Search for your roll number or application number inside the PDF to check whether you are on the provisionally shortlisted list or the not-shortlisted list.
  5. Save or print the relevant page for your records.

Important Instructions

  • Each PDF corresponds to only one post code opening the wrong PDF will not show your status.
  • This is a "disposal of representations" notification, meaning CSIR-NAL has reviewed candidate representations/objections before finalizing the list; specific grounds or number of representations disposed are not stated on the listing page.
  • For any further procedure after this final list (such as document verification or joining formalities), check the individual PDF, since that detail is not available on the summary listing page.

Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL), a Miniratna company and subsidiary of Coal India Limited under the Ministry of Coal, Government of India, has released the Joining Notice and Merit List for Graduate, Diploma and Paramedical Apprentice Trainees for the year 2026-27. The notice has been published on the official NCL website under the Apprenticeship Training section. Candidates who applied through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal for these three categories can now check their names in the category-wise merit list, along with the separate waiting list issued for each category.

Quick Overview - NCL Apprentice Merit List 2026

Particulars Details
Organization Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL), a subsidiary of Coal India Limited
Notice Type Joining Notice and Merit List for Apprentice Trainees
Categories Covered Graduate, Diploma and Paramedical Apprentice Trainees
Training Year 2026-27

Lists Released Merit List and Waiting List for each of the three categories
Mode of Release Online, via official NCL website (PDF format)

Important Dates

The joining notice PDF specifies reporting/joining dates and other scheme-related timelines. This information could not be independently extracted from the source document at the time of writing. Candidates should open the official Notice PDF (linked below) to check the exact joining date, reporting venue, and reporting time applicable to their category.

Documents Released With This Notice

NCL has published seven separate PDF documents along with this joining notice, covering the merit list and waiting list for each apprentice category:

  • Notice (main joining notice)
  • Merit List - Diploma (NATS) 2026-27
  • Merit List - Graduate (NATS) 2026-27
  • Merit List - Paramedical 2026-27
  • Waiting List - Diploma
  • Waiting List - Graduate
  • Waiting List - Paramedical

NCL Apprentice Merit List 2026-27: Category-Wise Details

Separate merit lists have been issued for each of the three apprentice categories under NATS. A separate waiting list has also been released for each category, to be used if any selected candidate from the merit list does not join.

Category Merit List Waiting List

The number of candidates shortlisted in each merit list and waiting list is mentioned inside the respective PDF and has not been reproduced here. Candidates should check their name, roll number, or application/enrollment ID directly in the relevant PDF using the links in the table below.

How to Check Your Name in the NCL Apprentice Merit List

  1. Open the merit list PDF relevant to your category (Graduate, Diploma, or Paramedical) from the Important Links section below.
  2. Use your NATS enrollment ID, roll number, or registered name to locate your entry, as specified in the PDF.
  3. If your name does not appear in the merit list, check the corresponding waiting list PDF for your category.
  4. Read the main Notice PDF for joining instructions, required documents, and reporting details before proceeding.
  5. Keep a printed or saved copy of the merit list/waiting list entry and the notice for reference during joining.

Important Instructions

  • This joining notice applies specifically to the Graduate, Diploma and Paramedical Apprentice categories under NATS; it does not cover ITI Trade Apprentices registered under NAPS.
  • Candidates are advised to read the full Notice PDF carefully, as it contains the official joining process, reporting requirements, and any category-specific instructions.
  • Selection is based on the merit list; candidates on the waiting list may be considered only if vacancies remain after the merit-listed candidates join.
  • For any updates, corrigenda, or changes to the joining schedule, candidates should keep checking the official NCL website rather than relying on third-party sources.

How to Check RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Result 2026

  1. Visit the official website of your respective Railway Recruitment Board (the RRB zone you applied under).
  2. Look for the notification titled "Result of 1st Stage CBT for CEN 07/2025 (NTPC Undergraduate)" under the Results or Latest Updates section.

  4. Use Ctrl+F (desktop) or the search option in your PDF viewer (mobile) and type your Roll Number to locate your status quickly.
  5. If your Roll Number appears in the list, you have been provisionally shortlisted for the 2nd Stage CBT.
  6. From 26 August 2026 (5:00 PM), log in on the official scorecard portal using your Registration Number and Date of Birth to view your individual normalized marks.

  • Keep checking the official RRB website regularly for the CBT 2 exam city intimation slip and admit card release dates, which have not been announced yet.
  • Retain a printout of the result PDF, scorecard, and original application documents for future reference.
  • In case of any discrepancy in your scorecard or result status, refer to the official notice on your regional RRB website for the grievance/query redressal process.

SSC MTS Havaldar Tie-Resolution Criteria

If two or more candidates score the same marks, SSC resolves ties using the following order:

  1. Candidate with higher normalised marks in the General Awareness section of Session II
  2. Candidate with higher overall normalised marks in Session II
  3. Candidate who is older in age (based on Date of Birth)
  4. If the tie still remains, candidates are ranked in alphabetical order of their names

The individual scorecard link went live on the official recruitment page on 1 August 2026 and can be accessed through a registration-based login on the ibpsreg.ibps.in portal. This article explains how to download your scorecard, what it contains, the qualifying marks, and the last date to access it.

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Candidate's roll number and registration number
  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified) for that stage

Also Read: UP TGT 2026 Special Document Verification Admit Card

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Link to View Individual Scorecard" under the Local Bank Officer recruitment section.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.
  8. Take a printout and store it safely you will need it during document verification and joining formalities.

PNB LBO Written Exam Qualifying Marks (Cut Off)

As reported by exam-preparation portals covering this recruitment cycle, candidates were required to clear both an overall cut off and a minimum sectional cut off in the online written test:

Category Minimum Marks Required Per Section
General / EWS 40%
SC / ST / OBC / PwBD 35%

Note: These sectional cut off percentages are drawn from exam-reporting sources and are consistent with the standard IBPS-pattern cut off structure used in this recruitment; they are Not Available Officially as an explicitly stated figure on PNB's own notice text reviewed for this article. Candidates should cross-check exact figures against their own scorecard.

Separately, some exam-prep sources report an interview qualifying score of 25 out of 50 for General category candidates and 22.5 out of 50 for SC/ST candidates. This detail is Not Available Officially on PNB's recruitment notice board and should be treated as unconfirmed until verified against the official result document.

  • Final Result / Provisional Selection intimation
  • Valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Driving License, etc.)
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Proof of post-qualification banking experience (as applicable to the LBO eligibility criteria)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), if applicable
  • Recent passport-size photographs

Important Instructions

  • The scorecard link is active only for a limited window (1 August to 31 August 2026). Download it before the window closes.

  • Report any discrepancy in personal details on the scorecard to PNB/IBPS immediately rather than proceeding with an incorrect document.
  • PNB has issued a public notice warning candidates against paying any money to anyone for interview calls, selection, or appointment. The bank does not charge any fee for these purposes.

Why Was the Reserve List Released?

After the CRP RRBs-XIV final result, a primary list of selected candidates was allotted to participating rural banks.   • Induction/Training Process

  2. Go to the "Careers" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on "Recruitment" from the drop-down menu.
  4. Look for the link titled "Junior Engineer Result 2026" under the recruitment notices.
  5. Your scorecard/result will open on screen check your details carefully.
  6. Download and save the PDF, and take a printout for future reference.

  • Candidate's Name
  • Registration Number
  • Discipline Applied For (Civil/Electrical)
  • Marks Obtained
  • Qualifying Status
  • Category Details
  • Cut-Off Marks

What Happens After the RBI JE Result 2026?

Candidates shortlisted in the RBI JE Result 2026 will next appear for a Language Proficiency Test (LPT) and Document Verification. Shortlisted candidates must print the required form, fill it correctly, and send it by Courier or Speed Post along with copies of the required certificates to the Regional Director of the Human Resource Management Department at the address for their Recruitment Zone. These documents must reach the concerned office within 10 days from the date of result declaration (i.e., by around 24 July 2026, counting from the 14 July 2026 release date). Candidates must clearly write "Junior Engineer (Civil/Electrical) – Panel Year 2026" on the envelope.

For context, this result relates to the RBI Junior Engineer recruitment notified for 11 posts (Civil and Electrical), for which the online application window ran from 16 April 2026 to 06 May 2026, and the CBT was held on 06 June 2026.

Karnataka UGCET 2026 Round 2 counselling, conducted by the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), has moved into its final and most time-sensitive stage. After declaring the Round 2 final seat allotment result, KEA revised the post-allotment schedule for choice selection, fee payment, and physical reporting at allotted colleges. Candidates allotted a seat in Round 2 must act within the window given below to avoid losing their seat. This article explains the complete revised UGCET 2026 Round 2 schedule, the choice options available to allotted candidates, fee and document requirements, and what happens next in the counselling process, based on KEA's official portal, cetonline.karnataka.gov.in, and its counselling circulars.

Direct Link to Karnataka UGCET 2026 Round 2 Revised Schedule Notice

Quick Overview - Karnataka UGCET 2026 Round 2

Particular Detail
Conducting Body Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
Counselling Name Karnataka UGCET (KCET) 2026 Counselling, Round 2
Official Website cetonline.karnataka.gov.in
Courses Covered Engineering, Architecture, Agricultural Science, Veterinary Science, Pharmacy, B.Sc Nursing, Yoga & Naturopathy, BPT, BPO, and other Allied Health Sciences programmes
Current Stage Post-allotment choice selection, fee payment, and college reporting (revised schedule)
Choice Options Available Choice 1 (Accept seat) and Choice 4 (Exit counselling) only - Choice 2 and Choice 3 are not available in this round

Karnataka UGCET 2026 Round 2: Important Dates (Revised Schedule)

Event Revised Date/ Time
Publication of vacant seat matrix and start of choice filling From 7:00 PM on August 7, 2026
Option entry, modification, and re-ordering window Extended up to 9:00 AM on August 20, 2026
Second mock seat allotment result August 17, 2026
Provisional seat allotment result August 23, 2026
Final Round 2 seat allotment result August 24, 2026 (a small number of reports list August 25, 2026 
Choice selection (Choice 1 or Choice 4) and fee payment window August 25 to August 27, 2026
Downloading of admission order / confirmation slip Available after fee payment, within the reporting window
Last date for physical reporting to allotted college (Choice 1 candidates) August 28, 2026

KEA has restricted Round 2 choice selection to only two options this year. Candidates allotted a seat must select one of the following before the deadline:

  • Choice 1 - Accept the seat: The candidate accepts the allotted college and course, pays the seat acceptance fee, downloads the admission order, and reports physically to the college within the given deadline. Candidates selecting Choice 1 exit the counselling process and are not eligible for further rounds.
  • Choice 4 - Reject and exit: The candidate does not accept the allotted seat and exits the KCET/ UGCET counselling process entirely. No fee payment is required for this option, but the candidate cannot participate in any subsequent round.

Candidates who wish to hold their Round 2 seat while still trying for an upgrade in a possible extended or mop-up round must check the official notification for the applicable seat-cancellation process, since Choice 2 (accept and upgrade) and Choice 3 (reject and upgrade) are not being offered in this round.

How to Complete Choice Selection and Check Karnataka UGCET 2026 Round 2 Status

  1. Visit the official KEA counselling portal at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in.
  2. Click on the link for "UGCET 2026 Round 2 Seat Allotment Result" under the Latest Announcements section.
  3. Log in using your CET application number and password or date of birth, as prompted.
  4. View your allotted college, course, and category status on the result page.
  5. Download and save the provisional/ final allotment letter.
  6. Select Choice 1 (accept) or Choice 4 (exit) within the given deadline.
  7. If Choice 1 is selected, proceed to pay the seat acceptance fee online and download the confirmation slip/ admission order.
  8. Report physically to the allotted college with the required original documents before the reporting deadline.

What Happens If You Miss the Deadline?

Based on KEA's counselling rules applied in previous years, candidates who fail to exercise any choice within the stipulated date and time typically have their allotted seat cancelled automatically. Karnataka UGCET 2026 candidates are strongly advised not to wait until the last hour, since the portal often experiences heavy traffic close to deadlines. The exact 2026 penalty clause was not independently confirmed for this article; candidates should refer to the official notification on the KEA portal for the precise consequence of a missed deadline this year.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Keep your CET application number, password, and registered mobile number handy, as these are required for login at every stage.
  • Cross-check your allotted college and course carefully before making a final choice, since Choice 1 is generally treated as final once fee payment is completed.
  • Save and print the admission order/ confirmation slip, as it is usually mandatory for physical reporting.
  • Keep track of any further schedule revision by regularly checking the "Latest Announcements" section of cetonline.karnataka.gov.in, since KEA has revised the UGCET 2026 counselling schedule multiple times this year.
  • For candidates considering a seat cancellation to try for a later round, verify the applicable cancellation fee and process directly from the official notification, as amounts can change between rounds.

IOB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Selection is through an Online Examination followed by a Personal Interview.
  • For Post Code 01 (Manager – Branch Management): the Online Examination has 100 questions/100 marks in 2 hours, covering English Language (25Q, 30 minutes) and Professional Knowledge – Banking Law & Practice, Indian Economy & Financial System, Principles & Practices of Banking, Accounting & Financial Management (75Q, 90 minutes).
  • For all other posts: the Online Examination has 100 questions/100 marks in 2 hours, covering English Language (25Q, 30 minutes), General Awareness with special reference to Banking Industry (25Q, 30 minutes), and Professional Knowledge, which varies post-wise (50Q, 60 minutes).
  • There is no minimum qualifying mark for General Awareness and English Language; candidates must secure minimum qualifying marks in Professional Knowledge.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in the Online Examination: 35% for unreserved candidates, 30% for reserved candidates.
  • 1/4th of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for a wrong answer; there is no penalty for unattempted questions.
  • The Interview carries a maximum of 100 marks, assessed on Role-related Industry Exposure, Subject Knowledge, and Communication Skills. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for unreserved, 45% for reserved candidates.
  • The final merit list is prepared with 80% weightage to the Online Examination and 20% weightage to the Interview.

Ration Card will not be accepted as a valid ID proof at any stage of this recruitment process.

How to Apply for IOB Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official IOB website, www.iob.bank.in, and open the "Careers" page.
  2. Click on "Recruitment of Generalist/Specialist Officers in Various Scales – 2026-27" and select the post to be applied for.
  3. Click "Register Online" and complete first-time registration.
  4. Note the system-generated Registration Number and Password sent via e-mail and SMS.
  5. Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
  6. Fill in all required details in the online application form carefully and click "Complete Registration."
  7. Pay the applicable Application Fee / Intimation Charges online (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/BHIM/UPI).
  8. Take a printout of the submitted application form and the payment e-receipt for future reference.

IOB Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Applications can be submitted online only, from 29.08.2026 to 15.09.2026; no other mode will be accepted.
  • Candidates may apply for more than one post, subject to fulfilling the eligibility criteria for each.
  • If a candidate submits multiple applications for the same post, only the last submitted application will be considered.
  • Incomplete applications or those without supporting documents will be rejected outright.
  • OBC candidates must submit a non-creamy layer certificate valid as on the date of interview.
  • The Bank reserves the right to change, modify, cancel, or add to any of the eligibility or selection criteria.
  • Outstation SC/ST/PWBD candidates who are unemployed will be reimbursed second-class train fare by the shortest route, as per Government guidelines.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Requests for change of examination centre, interview date, or registered e-mail ID will not be entertained.
  • The Online Examination will be conducted at centres including Delhi/NCR, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/MMR/Thane, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, and Bengaluru.

The Department of Posts (India Post), Ministry of Communications, Government of India, has released the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 notification vide Notification No. 17-12/2026-GDS dated 20 August 2026. Applications are invited from eligible candidates to fill tentative vacant posts of Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak in different offices of the Department of Posts across various Circles and Divisions in India. Interested candidates can apply online at the official GDS Online Engagement Portal.

Quick Answer: India Post (Department of Posts) is recruiting for Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) posts - Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak - under the Schedule-II, July-2026 engagement cycle. India Post has announced 23,757 tentative vacancies under the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) engagement. Candidates aged 18-40 years who have passed Class 10 (Secondary School Examination) with passing marks in Mathematics and English, and studied the prescribed local language up to 10th standard, can apply. Online One-Time Registration starts 31 August 2026, and online application submission runs from 2 September 2026 to 21 September 2026 (up to 1700 hrs), at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement, for postings in rural offices of the Department of Posts across India.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Salary (TRCA)

GDS are not regular Central Government employees; they are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carries an annual increase of 3% (subject to fulfilment of conditions under the GDS Rules), along with Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time. GDS are also entitled to GDS Gratuity and the Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to the National Pension System for regular employees).

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

There is no written examination for GDS engagement. Selection is entirely merit-based, computed from the candidate's Class 10 (SSE) academic record.

  • Applicants are shortlisted on the basis of a system-generated merit list
  • The merit list is prepared from marks obtained (or grades/points converted to marks) in the Secondary School Examination (10th standard), aggregated to a percentage up to 4 decimal places
  • Where only grades are given, marks are computed using a multiplication factor of 9.5 against the grade point (e.g., A1 = Grade Point 10 × 9.5); where CGPA is given, marks are computed as CGPA × 9.5, and the higher of the two (individual subject grades vs. CGPA) is taken if both are provided
  • Candidates must enter marks/grades exactly as shown on their marksheet - mixing marks and grades incorrectly, or entering grades where marks are required, can lead to cancellation/disqualification
  • Tie-breaking in the merit list follows a fixed priority order based on date of birth (older preferred) followed by category and gender combinations (ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, and so on down the prescribed order), with the Department reserving the right to apply additional tie-breaking criteria
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo physical verification of original documents by the Engaging Authority (Divisional/Unit Head), followed by an offer of provisional engagement, pre-engagement formalities (including 3 days of basic training and arranging accommodation), and final regularization after antecedent and document verification

How to Apply for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only, in two stages - One-Time Registration (OTR) followed by the Online Application Form.

  1. Visit the GDS Online Engagement Portal: https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  2. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) using a valid mobile number and email ID (verified via OTP), entering personal details and Class 10 board/year of passing information, to generate a unique Registration Number
  3. Log in using the Registration Number and password received via SMS, then click "Apply Online" under the "Active Notification" tab
  4. Fill in Personal Details, Board/Educational Details (Circle, Board Name, passing year, marks obtained), and select Division and post preferences based on eligible vacancies
  5. Upload a recent photograph (JPG/JPEG, 30-100 KB, 320×400 px, 4:5 aspect ratio) and signature (JPG/JPEG, 20-100 KB, 300×120 px, 5:2 aspect ratio) as per prescribed specifications
  6. Preview the application and make any corrections before final submission

UCO Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before January 1962, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from specified countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (subject to an eligibility certificate from the Government of India for the latter categories). Income Tax Department Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality: The candidate must be a citizen of India.
Post Age as on 01.07.2026 Essential Educational Qualification (as on 01.07.2026)
Tax Assistant (TA) 18 to 27 years A Degree from a recognized University or an equivalent qualification

This relaxation applies only to candidates who satisfy all other eligibility conditions related to education and sports qualification, and who furnish a certificate in the prescribed format as per Annexure-C of the notice.

Educational Qualification Cut-off: The essential educational qualification must be possessed on or before 01.07.2026; any qualification obtained after this date will not be considered.

Sports Eligibility: Meritorious sportspersons will be considered for appointment if they satisfy any one of the following:

  • Sportspersons who represented a State or the Country in National or International competitions; or medal winners in Junior National Championships, Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years), Khelo India Winter Games, Khelo India Para Games, Khelo India University Games, or School Games Federation of India (SGFI) events, in any of the games/sports listed above. For Chess: Grand Master (GM) Title, International Master (IM) Title, or Chess Olympiad participation (IM/GM title must be in the Open Category); National Open Chess Championship is treated as a National Championship, and medal-winning performance in the National Team Chess Championship is also considered.
  • Sportspersons who represented their University in Inter-University Tournaments conducted by the Inter-University Sports Boards, in any of the listed games/sports.
  • Sportspersons who represented State School Teams in National Sports/Games for Schools conducted by the All India School Games Federation, in any of the listed games/sports.

No appointment can be made unless the candidate is eligible in all respects — age, educational, and experience qualifications — except to the extent relaxation has been permitted for the applicable class/category.

Income Tax Department Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Selection Criteria (Order of Preference)

  1. Candidates who represented the country in an International Competition with clearance from the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
  2. Candidates who represented a State/UT in Senior or Junior level National Championships (organized by recognized National Sports Federations, or National Games organized by the Indian Olympic Association) and won a medal or position up to 3rd place; between Senior and Junior National participants, Senior National medal winners are preferred.
  3. Candidates who represented a University in an Inter-University competition (conducted by the Association of Indian Universities/Inter-University Sports Board) or Khelo India University Games, and won a medal or position up to 3rd place in finals.
  4. Candidates who represented a State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (above 18 years), Khelo India Winter Games, or Khelo India Para Games, and won a medal or position up to 3rd place in finals.
  5. Candidates who represented State Schools in National Sports/Games for Schools (conducted by the All-India School Games Federation) and won a medal or position up to 3rd place.
  6. Candidates who represented a State/UT/University/State Schools Team at the levels above (categories 2–5) but did not win a medal or position, in the same order of preference.
  • Only participation/achievements between 01.01.2022 and 30.06.2026 will be considered; the closing date of the tournament/event must fall within this range.
  • Candidates must be clear in all Doping Tests conducted by WADA/NADA or other relevant authorities, and must not have been disqualified or banned by any sports federation for disciplinary reasons. Any ongoing doping/unfair-means investigation must be disclosed as per Annexure-B.
  • Tie-break: higher sporting achievement during 01.01.2022–30.06.2026 first; if still tied, higher number of cumulative medals during the same period.
  • Individual and team events/games receive the same preference; except in a tie, no extra preference is given for winning more than one medal/position.

Certificates evidencing sports participation/achievement are accepted only from the prescribed competent authority for each competition level:

National/Sports/Games for Schools Director or Additional/Joint/Deputy Director in overall charge of Sports/Games for Schools in the State's Directorate of Public Instructions/Education Form 4
Khelo India University/Youth/Winter/Para Games Officer designated/in-charge from Sports Authority of India (SAI) Form 5

Income Tax Department Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  1. Applications are scrutinized for nationality, age, educational qualification, and best sporting performances between 01.01.2022 and 30.06.2026.
  2. Eligible shortlisted candidates are called before the Selection Committee for Document Verification of attested photocopies and Forms submitted with the application; only documents submitted with the original application are considered.
  3. Candidates already employed must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer at Document Verification.
  4. Shortlisted candidates then undergo a Ground/Field Proficiency Test to evaluate their proficiency in the respective Sport/Game.
  5. Candidates shortlisted for Tax Assistant (TA) must additionally qualify a Data Entry Skill Test at 8,000 key depressions per hour.
  6. Final selection is made strictly in order of merit, based on evaluation of best performances (01.01.2022–30.06.2026) combined with marks from the Ground/Field Proficiency Test.

Success at any stage of the selection process confers no right to appointment unless the Department is satisfied, after any enquiry it considers necessary, that the candidate is suitable in all respects. The venue for Document Verification and the Ground/Field Proficiency Test will be intimated to shortlisted candidates in due course.

IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Note: The 31-page detailed advertisement does not itself carry a vacancy table - IOCL has published the post-wise and category-wise breakup in a separate vacancy annexure alongside the main notification. Figures below are compiled from that official annexure.

IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Eligibility (Post-wise)

1. Graduate Engineer (Grade A)

Full-time regular B.Tech/BE/equivalent degree from an AICTE/UGC-recognized institution in one of the following domains: Chemical, Civil, Computer Science & IT, Electrical, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, or Mechanical Engineering.

Category Minimum Marks
General/EWS/OBC(NCL) 65%
SC/ST/PwBD 55%

2. Officer (Marketing) – Grade A

Full-time 2-year MBA / PGDBA (equivalent to MBA as per AIU) with specialization in Marketing Management. General/EWS/OBC(NCL): 60% marks minimum; SC/ST/PwBD: 55% marks minimum. The specialization must be reflected on the final degree certificate.

3. Law Officer (Grade A)

Graduate degree in any discipline plus LLB, OR a 5-year Integrated LLB, recognized by the Bar Council of India. General/EWS/OBC(NCL): 60% marks in each qualifying degree; SC/ST/PwBD: 55% marks. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification work experience (as on 30.06.2026) is required in litigation, law firms, or legal functions with private/public organizations or government, in areas such as litigation, arbitration/ADR, or drafting and vetting of legal/contractual documents.

4. Assistant Quality Control Officer (Grade A0)

Master’s degree in Chemistry (Inorganic/Organic/Analytical/Physical/Applied/Industrial Chemistry). General/EWS/OBC(NCL): 60% marks minimum; SC/ST/PwBD: 55% marks minimum. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in Testing/R&D/Quality Control in a petroleum, petrochemical, polymer, or fertilizer laboratory, and/or in an NABL-accredited lab (Chemical discipline, Lubricants/Petroleum group).

5. Diploma Engineer (Grade E0)

3-year full-time Diploma in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or Safety-related disciplines as listed in the official notification). General/EWS/OBC(NCL): 65% marks minimum; SC/ST: 55% marks minimum. Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech, MBA, CA, CS, CMA, MCA, or Ph.D. are not eligible for this post. For the Safety discipline, an additional Diploma in Industrial Safety (minimum 1 year) is required.

Important: For the Diploma Engineer (Safety) post, PwBD candidates are not eligible, as the notification states this is a hazardous-industry role involving critical safety operations.

Common Eligibility Points

  • Candidates must produce their final degree/marksheet by 30 September 2026.
  • Qualifications acquired through Part-time/Correspondence/Distance/Online learning modes are not eligible.
  • CGPA/grade-based results must be converted to percentage as per the respective institute's official conversion formula.
  • Candidates must be Indian nationals with an outstanding academic record.

IOCL Executive Recruitment Selection Process

Selection comprises three stages: Computer Based Test (CBT), Group Discussion (GD) & Group Task (GT), and Personal Interview (PI).

CBT Pattern

Section Subject Questions Time
A – General Aptitude Quantitative Aptitude 20 60 min (80 min with compensatory time)
Logical Reasoning 15
Verbal Ability (English) 15
B – Domain Knowledge Post-specific technical/domain questions 50 90 min (120 min with compensatory time)
Total 100 150 min
  • Each question carries 1 mark; 0.25 marks deducted for every incorrect answer.
  • Section order is fixed - Section A first, then Section B.
  • CBT will be held at 83 test centers across India (city list available in the official notification and syllabus link below).

Qualifying Standard in CBT

Category Each Section (A & B) Overall Minimum
General/EWS/OBC(NCL) 40% 45%
SC/ST 35% 40%
PwBD 25% 30%

Composite Score Weightage

Component Weightage
Computer Based Test (CBT) 85%
Group Discussion (GD) & Group Task (GT) 5%
Personal Interview (PI) 10%

Minimum composite score required: General/EWS/OBC(NCL) – 45%, SC/ST – 40%, PwBD – 30%. GD/GT and PI each require a minimum 40% pass mark.

How to Apply for IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website www.iocl.com and click "Apply Online."
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Log in and fill the application form; use "Save and Next" to save progress at each stage.
  4. Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20–50 KB), signature (10–20 KB), and left thumb impression (20–50 KB) as per specifications.
  5. Capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone as prompted by the portal.
  6. Fill in educational, category, and other required details.
  7. Preview the form carefully, then click "Complete Registration" - no changes are allowed after this step.
  8. Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the application fee online.
  9. Click "Submit" and download/print the completed application form and e-receipt for your records.
Important: Only one application per post is allowed; in case of multiple applications, the latest one is treated as final. SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempt from the application fee; all other candidates must pay ₹1,000 + GST.

Documents Required

  • Qualifying degree/diploma certificate and mark sheets (as applicable to the post)
  • CGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate, if applicable
  • Work experience proof (for Law Officer and Assistant Quality Control Officer posts) on organizational letterhead
  • Bar Council of India registration certificate (for Law Officer candidates with independent practice)
  • Birth date proof (Board of Secondary Education matriculation/higher-secondary certificate)
  • Category certificate (EWS/OBC(NCL)/SC/ST), as applicable, in the latest prescribed format
  • PwBD certificate and UDID card, where applicable
  • Valid photo identity proof (PAN/Passport/Driving License/Voter ID/Aadhaar, etc.)
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer, if presently employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous Body

Important Conditions

  • Candidates having their graduation/diploma in combined, integrated, or interdisciplinary subjects (e.g., Mechatronics, Robotics) are not eligible for the Graduate Engineer or Diploma Engineer posts.
  • No change of category (Gen/EWS/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD) is permitted once submitted in the online application.
  • Selected candidates will be placed anywhere in India, including overseas offices, at Corporation discretion.
  • Final selection is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates, testimonials, and medical fitness.
  • Candidates must clear Pre-Employment Medical Examination (PEME) guidelines before joining.
  • Any use of unfair means, impersonation, or misconduct during the process will lead to disqualification and may result in debarment from future IOCL examinations.
  • IOCL reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify, or alter the recruitment/selection process without prior notice.

TMB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for all posts is through a Personal Interview only - there is no written examination. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview through Direct mode or Video Conferencing, and the mode, date, and time of the interview will be communicated to eligible candidates individually. The Bank's decision on eligibility, conduct of interview, and selection is final, and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.

How to Apply for TMB Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the Bank's careers website, https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/, and download the detailed advertisement for the relevant post before applying.
  2. Click "Apply Online" and register for the specific post using a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number.
  3. On successful registration, an activation link will be sent to the registered e-mail ID, and a Registration Number and Password will be sent to the registered mobile number - note these carefully, as they are required to proceed.
  4. Click the activation link sent to your e-mail, which will direct you to the careers portal.
  5. Log in using the Application/Registration Number and password, and fill in all details carefully, clicking "Save/Continue" on every page. Ensure your name and your father's/husband's name are spelt exactly as they appear on your certificates/mark sheets.
  6. Upload your photograph (390 x 520 pixels preferred, maximum 120 KB) and signature (240 x 240 pixels preferred, maximum 60 KB, not in capital letters) in the specified format.
  7. Upload the following enclosures, each not exceeding 250 KB: self-attested copy of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate (for age proof), self-attested copy of Degree Certificate(s), Experience Certificate(s) and Relieving Letter for previous employment, and last month's salary slip.
  8. Review all details, then click "Confirm/Submit" - a message confirming "Registration is successful" will be displayed on successful submission.
  9. A copy of the system-generated application form will be sent to your registered e-mail; take a printout for future reference.

TMB Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Applications can be submitted only online through TMB's website; no other mode of submission will be accepted by the Bank.
  • Candidates must register with a correct, valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, and keep them active until the recruitment process is complete, as call letters may be sent by e-mail.
  • Any change or alteration found in the name of the candidate or their father's/husband's name (compared to certificates/mark sheets) may disqualify the candidature.
  • e-Applications with incorrect or incomplete particulars, or without the required certificate copies attached, are liable to be rejected.
  • Candidates should adhere strictly to the eligibility conditions given; any information found to be wrong, or any candidate found ineligible at any stage of the process or later, will result in disqualification.
  • The Bank reserves the right to reject any application, or eliminate ineligible candidates, at any point before, during, or after the interview/selection process, without assigning any reason, and the Bank's decision in these matters is final.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • The job role and location for all posts are subject to transfer based on the Bank's requirements.

RRB JE/DMS/CMA Selection Process 2026

Selection comprises four stages: 1st Stage CBT (CBT-I), 2nd Stage CBT (CBT-II), Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (ME).

  • Negative marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer in both CBTs.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: UR & EWS 40%, OBC-NCL 30%, SC 30%, ST 25% (relaxable by up to 2 marks for PwBD candidates where PwBD vacancies are short of eligible candidates).
  • CBT-II shortlisting: 15 times the community-wise vacancy per RRB, based on CBT-I merit.
  • DV shortlisting: equal to the number of vacancies, based on CBT-II merit using a normalized Merit Index across Exam Groups.

How to Apply for RRB JE/DMS/CMA Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official RRB website or rrbapply.gov.in and Create an Account (mandatory personal mobile number and email ID; these cannot be changed later).
  2. Log in and select CEN No. 04/2026 (JE/DMS/CMA).
  3. Choose one RRB only and indicate zone/post preferences in order - this choice is final and cannot be changed.
  4. Fill in personal, educational and category details carefully.
  5. Complete live photo capture (webcam/front camera) as per the prescribed guidelines; upload signature (JPG/JPEG, 30–49 KB).
  6. Upload SC/ST certificate (PDF, under 400 KB) if opting for free train travel facility.
  7. Pay the applicable examination fee online (internet banking / debit-credit card / UPI).
  8. Submit the application; note down your Registration Number.
  9. Use the modification window (16.09.2026 to 25.09.2026) if corrections are needed, on payment of ₹250 per modification.
Important: Multiple applications to different RRBs, or multiple applications to the same RRB, will lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams.

Important Conditions

  • Only one application per candidate against this CEN is permitted; multiple applications lead to rejection and debarment.
  • Vacancies are provisional and may increase, decrease, or become nil, per Railway Administration requirements.
  • A candidate with more than one qualifying discipline may choose only one Exam Group, and is then eligible only for posts mapped to that group.
  • Medical fitness as per the prescribed Medical Standard (A-3/B-1/B-2/C-1, as applicable to the post) is mandatory; no alternative appointment is given if found unfit.
  • Once a category/post/RRB is allotted, candidates forfeit the right to be considered for any other post/category in the same pay level.
  • Use of unfair means, impersonation, or false information leads to lifetime debarment from RRB/RRC exams and possible legal action.

The State Bank of India (SBI), Central Recruitment & Promotion Department, Corporate Centre, Mumbai, has released the notification for SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026, inviting applications from eligible Indian citizens for the post of Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) in the clerical cadre. The recruitment is published under Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17, and covers 7,680 regular vacancies plus 1,444 backlog vacancies across 24 States/UTs.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (As on 31.12.2026)

Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University, or any equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government. Candidates in their final year/semester of graduation may also apply provisionally, subject to producing proof of having passed the graduation examination on or before 31.12.2026.

Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education, or the corresponding certificate in the Navy or Air Force, after completing not less than 15 years of service in the Armed Forces of the Union, are also eligible. Such certificates should be dated on or before 31.12.2026.

Age Limit (As on 01.04.2026)

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Reservation

  • 4% horizontal reservation is provided to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), as per Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, for categories including Blind/Low Vision, Deaf/Hard of Hearing, locomotor disabilities (one/both arms, one/both legs, cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims, muscular dystrophy, spinal deformity/injury), Autism Spectrum Disorder (mild), intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness, and multiple disabilities.
  • 4.5% of total vacancies are reserved for Disabled Ex-Servicemen and dependents of servicemen killed in action, in addition to the 10% earmarked for Ex-Servicemen (a total of 14.50%). First priority in appointment goes to Disabled Ex-Servicemen, and second priority to dependents of defence personnel killed in action or severely disabled (over 50% disability attributable to defence services).
  • Reservation for PwBD/XS/DXS candidates is horizontal and is included within the vacancies of the various parent categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/GEN) to which the candidate belongs.
  • OBC vacancies are available only to candidates in the "Non-Creamy Layer"; OBC candidates in the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to any OBC relaxation/reservation and must indicate their category as General.
  • Benefit of reservation under the EWS category requires an Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2025-26, valid for 2026-27, issued by a Competent Authority on the Government of India format.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Salary

The pay scale for Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) is Rs. 24,050-1340/3-28,070-1650/3-33,020-2000/4-41,020-2340/7-57,400-4400/1-61,800-2680/1-64,480. The starting Basic Pay is Rs. 26,730 (Rs. 24,050 plus two advance increments admissible to graduates).

The total starting emoluments of a Clerical Cadre employee posted at a Metro like Mumbai will be around Rs. 46,000 per month, inclusive of Dearness Allowance, other allowances at the current rate, and two additional increments for newly recruited graduate Junior Associates. Allowances may vary depending on the place of posting. Selected candidates will be eligible for reimbursement of various perquisites, provident fund, pension under the New Pension Scheme (Defined Contribution Benefit), medical, leave-fare, and other facilities as per Bank instructions issued from time to time.

  • Caste certificate (for SC/ST candidates), OBC non-creamy layer certificate, or EWS Income and Asset Certificate, as applicable, to be submitted at the time of joining
  • Discharge certificate from employer, for candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government offices, PSUs, Nationalised Banks, or Financial Institutions, at the time of appointment, if selected

How to Apply for SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the Bank's website, https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings.
  2. Scroll down and click on the relevant advertisement, then download and carefully read Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17.
  3. Register online under "Recruitment of Junior Associates 2026", providing your details in one sitting or saving and resuming (available up to three times before final submission).
  4. Upload your scanned photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per the specified guidelines, and capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone.
  5. Pay the requisite application fee online through debit card, credit card, or Internet Banking (fee is Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/XS/DXS, and ₹750 for General/OBC/EWS candidates).
  6. Review your application carefully before final submission - no corrections or edits are allowed after final submission.
  7. Submit the application before the last date, 31.08.2026, and take a printout of the system-generated application form for your own record (this printout is not to be sent to SBI).

For any problem in filling up the form, payment of fee, or receipt of admission/call letter, candidates may contact the helpdesk at 022-22820427 (between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM on Bank working days) or lodge a query at http://cgrs.ibps.in, mentioning 'Recruitment of Junior Associate-2026' in the subject line.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained, and the fee paid for other registrations will be forfeited.
  • Request for change or correction of any particulars, including category, once the application is submitted, will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute connectivity issues; SBI will not be responsible for failure to submit an application due to heavy website traffic or reasons beyond its control.
  • Mobile phones, pagers, smart watches, calculators, or any other communication/electronic devices are not allowed inside the examination premises.
  • The Bank may capture thumb impressions or IRIS scans at various stages for biometric verification; any inconsistency may lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, or misbehaviour during the examination may be disqualified, debarred from future Bank examinations, and held liable for criminal prosecution.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • No hard copy of the call letter (Preliminary/Main) or the "Acquaint Yourself" booklet will be sent by post; candidates must download these from the Bank's website.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being declared medically fit and satisfactory completion of Know Your Employee (KYE) formalities, as well as the Bank's service and conduct rules.
  • Any legal proceedings relating to this advertisement or an application can only be instituted in Mumbai; courts, tribunals, and forums at Mumbai alone have jurisdiction.
  • The role requires flair for marketing and customer calls, banking, advisory, and cross-selling duties, both inside and outside Bank premises, with possible extensive outdoor travel and flexible working hours/shifts.
  • Decisions of the Bank in all matters regarding eligibility, conduct of tests, and selection are final and binding on all candidates; no representation or correspondence will be entertained.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • State Bank of India does not endorse, authorize, or associate with any external coaching platform, consultancy, individual, or digital channel claiming to provide guaranteed selection or insider guidance. Candidates must rely solely on information available on SBI's official career portal.

BOB Local Bank Officer Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfil the following eligibility conditions, assessed as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026, to apply for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026.

Criteria Details
Nationality Citizen of India, or subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with intent to permanently settle, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intent to permanently settle in India
Educational Qualification Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution (mandatory)
Preferred Certifications IC 38 (Insurance Institute of India), NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors), NISM Series XXI-A (PMS Distributors), NISM Series XIII (Common Derivatives)
Post-Qualification Experience Minimum 1 year as an Officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank listed in the Second Schedule of the Reserve Bank of India
Language Proficiency Must be proficient (reading, writing, speaking, understanding) in the local language of the state applied for

Candidates who have resigned from an officer-grade position in Bank of Baroda, or exited the Bank while on contract within the last three years as on the cut-off date, are not eligible to apply. Employees currently working in Bank of Baroda in the officer cadre or on contract basis are also not eligible.

There is no reservation for Ex-Servicemen in the Officers' Cadre; only age relaxation as above applies. OBC candidates in the "creamy layer" are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation.

BOB Local Bank Officer Selection Process

Selection for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following stages:

  • Online Test (multiple sections, described below)
  • Group Discussion (GD) and/or Personal Interview (PI)
  • Psychometric Test and/or any other assessment as deemed suitable by the Bank
  • Local Language Proficiency Test (LPT), where applicable

The tentative structure of the online examination is as follows:

The English Language section is qualifying in nature only, and marks scored in it will not count towards the final merit list. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. The minimum qualifying marks for GD/PI are 60% for General category and 55% for Reserved category candidates. Candidates must qualify in the Local Language Proficiency Test unless they have studied the local language at the 10th or 12th standard level.

NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL), a subsidiary of NTPC Limited, has released Advertisement No. 04/26 to fill 147 vacancies across eight Engineer and Executive posts in the Renewable Energy (RE) segment. The engagement is on a fixed-term basis for 3 years, extendable by up to 2 years at the organisation's discretion. Online applications opened on 18 August 2026 at 10:00 Hrs and close on 7 September 2026 at 18:00 Hrs. Eligible Indian nationals can apply through the careers section of the official NGEL website, www.ngel.in.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria and Qualification

Every post under NGEL Recruitment 2026 has its own qualification, experience and job-summary requirements. Candidates should check the post they intend to apply for carefully, since a candidate can apply for only one post among those advertised.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Civil) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Civil Engineering with at least 65% marks from a recognised university/institution (55% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in Geotech/piling/foundation/structural steel/tower structures/switchyard, etc. Candidates with RE experience are preferred.
  • Job summary: Civil system design, technical specifications for regulatory compliance of solar, wind and other RE projects, contract management, quality assurance, equipment erection, installation, testing, commissioning, and O&M of the RE station.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Electrical) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Electrical, Instrumentation & Control/Power Systems & High Voltage/Power Electronics/Power Engineering with at least 65% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in switchyard/electrical testing/transmission system/transformer/design/engineering. RE experience in the plant/engineering domain is preferred.
  • Job summary: Electrical system design and technical specifications for solar, wind and other RE projects, contract management for equipment erection, installation, testing, commissioning and O&M.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Mechanical) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Mechanical/Production/Industrial Engineering/Production & Industrial Engineering/Power Engineering with at least 65% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD). Preference is given to candidates with an ME/M.Tech degree.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience involving supervision/execution in power generation (Thermal/Gas/Hydro/Nuclear/Renewables). RE experience is preferred.
  • Job summary: Design and engineering of mechanical systems for RE projects, site selection, tender documentation, AutoCAD drawings, vendor drawing approval, supervision of equipment installation and O&M, and processing of statutory compliances.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-Human Resource) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Graduate with at least a 2-year full-time Post Graduate Degree/Diploma/Programme in Management with specialisation in HR/Industrial Relations/Personnel Management, or MHROD, or MBA (HR) with at least 65% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in HR functions/Industrial Relations. Knowledge of SAP, MS Office and Data Analytics is preferred.
  • Job summary: Statutory labour-law compliance for RE areas, recruitment and onboarding, employee benefits and compensation, site infrastructure development, CSR execution around RE sites, and land acquisition/lease payment matters.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-Finance) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Qualified CA or CMA.
  • Experience: Minimum 1 year post-qualification executive experience (excluding articleship period) in Finance/Accounts.
  • Job summary: Vendor invoice processing and payments, statutory compliance (GST, TDS, etc.), preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements as per IndAS and SEBI LODR, statutory/internal/government audits, costing, budgeting, financial projections, resource mobilisation, working capital management and payroll accounting.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Safety) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Production/Electrical/Civil/Power Engineering with at least 65% marks (55% SC/ST/PwBD) plus a full-time Diploma in Industrial Safety from a Regional Labour Institute/institution recognised under the Factories Act/Rules; OR a full-time Engineering Degree in Industrial Safety/Fire & Safety with at least 65% marks from a university/institution recognised under the Factories Act/Rules of any state.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in safety, preferably in the power or manufacturing industry (Govt./PSU or a private company of repute). Post-qualification experience is counted from the date of acquiring the engineering degree. RE experience is preferred.
  • Job summary: Statutory safety compliance under the Factories Act, developing/auditing/improving factory safety systems, safety-consciousness promotion, machinery/equipment/building safety inspection, emergency management planning, and organising safety and fire-fighting training and mock drills.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-CSR) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time PG Degree/Diploma/Programme in Rural Management/Rural Development/Displacement/Resettlement/Rehabilitation/Community Development/Local Governance/Local Development/Livelihoods/Social Entrepreneurship/Social Development/Social Administration/Sustainable Development/Development Policy & Practice/Development Studies, or MSW, or MBA, or a Graduate in Engineering, with at least 65% marks (55% SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in conducting/reviewing/analysing/monitoring socio-economic surveys, stakeholder consultation through participatory tools, handling CSR activities under the Companies Act, need-assessment or social-impact-assessment surveys, or CSR project planning and implementation.
  • Job summary: Implementation of NGEL's CSR plan, drafting proposals, overseeing CSR activity execution, MIS preparation, payment processing, and handling internal and statutory CSR audits, reports and returns.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-Rajbhasha) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: A Master's Degree from a recognised university in Hindi (with English as compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination), or in English (with Hindi as compulsory/elective subject or medium), or in any other subject with Hindi medium and English as compulsory/elective/medium, or with English medium and Hindi as compulsory/elective/medium, or with both Hindi and English as compulsory/elective subjects or as medium and compulsory/elective subject, at the degree level. See the official notification for the exact combination of eligible qualifications.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification experience of using/applying terminology in Hindi or translation work from English to Hindi (or vice versa), under Central/State Government, Union Territories, autonomous bodies, statutory organisations, PSUs, universities, or recognised research and education institutions.
  • Job summary: Formation and coordination of the Official Language Implementation Committee, Hindi progress reports, organising Hindi Day/Fortnight and Hindi workshops, translation work (English to Hindi and vice versa), magazine editing, and implementation of Official Language Policy.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit and Relaxation

The upper age limit for all eight posts is 35 years, computed as on the last date of receipt of the online application. Age relaxation is available as per government norms:

  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • OBC candidates: 3 years relaxation
  • PwBD candidates: 10 years relaxation
  • Ex-Servicemen: relaxation as per applicable Government guidelines

Age relaxation applies where a vacancy is identified for that particular reserved category.

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

As per the notification, the approximate CTC for the advertised posts is Rs 11,00,000 per annum. This is indicative and includes both fixed and variable components, House Rent Allowance (HRA), Mediclaim for self, spouse, dependent parents and two children, performance-based variable pay, and a satisfactory service grant. The notification states that actual remuneration will depend on the candidate's experience, place of posting, and other terms and conditions of appointment.

Payment can be made online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, Pre-Paid Card, or UPI within the application form itself. The notification states that the fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates should verify their eligibility before paying.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

NGEL may conduct a multi-stage selection process comprising application shortlisting/screening, a Computer-Based Test (CBT), Group Discussion and/or Interview, or a combination of these, and reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards if required.

If Selection is Through CBT

  • The CBT is bilingual with multiple-choice questions and has two sections: Section 1 – Subject Knowledge Test (SKT) (discipline-specific questions) and Section 2 – Aptitude Test (AT) (numerical ability, reading comprehension, reasoning, general awareness, data interpretation).
  • The test has 100 questions and a duration of 2 hours.
  • There is negative marking: ¼ of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for every wrong answer.
  • Online CBT centres: Kolkata, Chennai, Delhi, Mumbai, Vishakhapatnam, Gandhinagar/Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Jaipur, Bhopal and Raipur.
  • Shortlisted candidates from the CBT are called for an interview.
Parameter Marks (Cumulative Score) Min. Qualifying Marks - UR Min. Qualifying Marks - Reserved (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD)

CBT - Aptitude Test (AT) 30% 22.5%

If No CBT is Conducted

Shortlisting will instead be done on the basis of age, qualification and experience, and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview directly.

Parameter Marks (Cumulative Score) Min. Qualifying Marks - UR Min. Qualifying Marks - Reserved (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD)
Experience 30 50% 50%
Interview 70 55% 45%
Total 100    

Additional notes on experience marking: 5 marks are awarded for meeting the minimum required experience, plus 1 additional mark for every extra year of experience, up to a maximum of 10 marks. The final offer of appointment is issued based on the candidate's relative rank in the merit list prepared from the cumulative total marks. Joining is subject to the candidate passing a medical examination at a specified government hospital and being declared medically fit.

Documents Required for NGEL Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload the following documents while applying online:

  1. Class X/Matriculation passing certificate/marksheet and PAN Card, as proof of name and date of birth (name and DOB must match across all documents).
  2. Engineering consolidated marksheet/transcript/all-semester marksheets showing aggregate percentage of marks, or the CA/CMA (ICWA) passing certificate, or Master's degree certificate with marksheets, as applicable.
  3. Marks conversion formula from the university/institute, for converting CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI into a percentage.
  4. Documents related to the essential qualification (pass certificate and marksheets, mode, duration, specialisation).
  5. Documents related to any other qualification (pass certificate and marksheets).
  6. Caste/Disability certificate, for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates, as applicable.
  7. OBC-NCL certificate in the central format for financial year 2026-27.
  8. EWS candidates: current-year Income & Asset certificate valid for FY 2026-27, based on FY 2025-26 income.
  9. Disability certificates as per the latest Central Government format, generated online through the Swalamban/UDID portal, clearly indicating the type and percentage of disability in line with the identified disability for the post.
  10. Documents supporting the requisite years of post-qualification executive experience - in chronological order from the most recent organisation backward - including experience certificate, appointment/offer/joining letter, confirmation letter or training-completion order (if any), promotion order, role-assignment order, transfer order, service certificate, relieving letter, and two payslips per year.
  11. Self-attested copies of age proof, marksheets/transcripts and certificates for all qualifications, and experience certificates from all organisations specifically mentioning area of specialisation/job performed/expertise.
  12. Candidates from Government organisations/PSUs must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview, or submit an undertaking to provide it within a stipulated time / obtain proper relieving before joining NGEL, if selected.

How to Apply for NGEL Recruitment 2026 - NGEL Apply Online

  1. Visit the careers section of the official NGEL website, www.ngel.in. No other mode of application is accepted.
  2. Register with a valid, active email ID, since NGEL will not be responsible for any bounced-back emails.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility

Eligibility is specific to each discipline code, as detailed below. In all cases, the qualification must be from a recognised University/Institute pursued as a full-time regular course; qualifications acquired through part-time, correspondence, or distance learning are not eligible.

Discipline Code Post Qualification
101 Technician Apprentice (Mechanical) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, minimum 50% aggregate (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% (SC/ST/PwBD for reserved positions), from an AICTE/UGC-recognised institute/university
102 Technician Apprentice (Electrical) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical Engineering, same marks criteria as above
103 Technician Apprentice (Instrumentation) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering, same marks criteria as above
104 Technician Apprentice (Civil) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Civil Engineering, same marks criteria as above
105 Technician Apprentice (Electrical & Electronics) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, same marks criteria as above
106 Technician Apprentice (Electronics) 3-year regular full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering, same marks criteria as above
107 Trade Apprentice (Fitter) Matriculation with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Fitter) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT; pass marks sufficient
108 Trade Apprentice (Electrician) Matriculation with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electrician) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT; pass marks sufficient
109 Trade Apprentice (Electronics Mechanic) Matriculation with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT; pass marks sufficient
110 Trade Apprentice (Instrument Mechanic) Matriculation with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT; pass marks sufficient
111 Trade Apprentice (Machinist) Matriculation with regular full-time 2-year ITI (Machinist) course recognised by NCVT/SCVT; pass marks sufficient
112 Graduate Apprentice (BBA/BA/B.Com/B.Sc.) Regular full-time Graduate in any discipline, minimum 50% aggregate (General/EWS/OBC-NCL) or 45% (SC/ST/PwBD for reserved positions), from an AICTE/UGC-recognised institute/university
113 Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator (Fresher) Class 12th pass (below graduate)
114 Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) Class 12th pass (below graduate) plus a Skill Certificate in 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' (training of less than one year) issued by a body recognised under the National Skill Qualifications Framework or another Central Government-recognised authority

Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Where CGPA/OGPA/Letter Grade is awarded, the equivalent aggregate percentage must be indicated in the online application as per the norms of the concerned Board/University/Institute, with a supporting certificate furnished at document verification.
  • A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings, and the second must be in a different trade, with a minimum one-year gap between the two (subject to conditions specified in the notification for terminated contracts).
  • Candidates applying under NATS or NAPS who have completed five years in the relevant discipline (as on 31.08.2026) after acquiring the prescribed qualification are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as B.E., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB, or equivalent (completed on or before joining) are NOT eligible.
  • Diploma or Vocational Certificate holders with one year or more of job experience after acquiring the qualification are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates whose apprenticeship contract has already been approved by BOAT on the NATS portal cannot create a second apprenticeship contract, even if the earlier one is later terminated.
  • Candidates can apply for ONLY ONE discipline code; applying for more than one will lead to summary rejection of all applications.

PwBD (OBC-NCL) Up to 13 years' relaxation over the base limit

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Stipend

The stipend payable to apprentices is governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961, the Apprentices Rules, 1992, and applicable amendments/guidelines. In addition to the statutory stipend, IOCL (MD), NR will pay ₹2,500 per month towards miscellaneous expenses. For Graduate and Technician Apprentices, a portion of the stipend is disbursed directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the apprentice's Aadhaar-seeded bank account by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT). Trade Apprentices (NAPS apprentices) receive their full stipend directly from IOCL (MD), NR. These arrangements are subject to change as per government/BOAT/NAPS guidelines issued from time to time. A specific fixed monthly stipend amount is not stated in the official notification.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Application Start Date 07 August 2026, 10:00 AM
Application Last Date (NAPS/NATS portal + Microsoft Office Form) 06 September 2026, 5:00 PM
Document Verification for Shortlisted Candidates Intimated on registered email ID (specific date not fixed)
Cutoff/Reckoning Date (Age & Qualification) 31 August 2026

Any change in dates will be communicated only through the official IOCL website, so candidates are advised to check it regularly.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  1. Online Application: Candidates registered on the NAPS/NATS portal and applying against the notification are considered for selection. There is no written test or interview.
  2. Merit List: Prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the prescribed qualification for the respective post. Ties are resolved first by earlier date of birth, and then by higher marks in matriculation if the date of birth is also the same.
  3. Preference: Given to candidates applying for apprenticeship training for the first time.
  4. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification.
  5. Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test: Candidates must be adjudged medically fit as per IOCL's pre-engagement medical standards.
  6. Offer of Engagement: Issued to candidates who successfully clear document verification and the medical fitness test. Up to ₹3,000 is reimbursed towards expenses incurred for pre-engagement medical tests/investigations, on production of receipts.
