IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Required Documents

The following original documents, along with self-attested copies, must be furnished at document verification:

  • Matriculation (Class X) mark sheet/certificate issued by the Board of Secondary Education - the only acceptable proof of date of birth.
  • Latest caste certificate (for reserved category candidates) in the Government-prescribed proforma, issued by a competent authority.
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed Government of India format, issued on or after 01.09.2025 (not more than 12 months old as on 31.08.2026), for candidates claiming OBC-NCL reservation.
  • Certificate from the institute confirming the candidate pursued the course through regular mode, with the year of passing.
  • Semester-wise/year-wise mark sheets of ITI (NCVT/SCVT)/HSC/Graduation/Diploma in Engineering, as applicable.
  • Final ITI (NCVT/SCVT) Certificate/HSC/Graduation/Diploma in Engineering certificate issued by the respective Board/Authority/Institute.
  • Copy of the first page of the bank passbook of the Aadhaar-seeded account, Aadhaar card, PAN card, and a cancelled cheque leaf.
  • Pre-engagement medical fitness certificate.

How to Apply for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Register as a Graduate/Technician/Trade Apprentice on the applicable portal for your state:
    • Trade Apprentice (ITI): NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator: NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice (Diploma): NATS portal - nats.education.gov.in
    • Graduate Apprentice: NATS portal - nats.education.gov.in
  2. Ensure your profile (personal details, educational details, category, aggregate percentage) is complete and correct before applying; corrections must be made through the NAPS/NATS office.
  3. Log in to the respective NATS/NAPS portal and apply for the opportunity using IOCL (MD)-Northern Region's Establishment ID: NATS – NDLSDC000005; NAPS – E05200700003.
  4. After applying on the NAPS/NATS portal, also submit your details, preferred state, and three preferred locations via the Microsoft Office Form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/pw7D2cUK7c
  5. Both the NAPS/NATS application and the Microsoft Office Form must be completed by 06 September 2026, 5:00 PM. Only one Microsoft Form response is allowed - multiple submissions will not be entertained.
  6. Apply for only ONE discipline code; applying for more than one will lead to rejection of the application.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates must have a valid, active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number on NAPS/NATS, and 100% completion of their profile.
  • Candidates must have an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least 1 year, as all communication regarding document verification/engagement will be sent only via email/SMS.
  • Candidates must possess a PAN card, an Aadhaar card, and an active bank account with a cheque book (same account as updated on the NATS portal), seeded to Aadhaar and enabled for DBT, along with an updated APAAR ID and e-KYC verification on the NATS portal.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats will be considered only if they meet the standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • Candidates registered with a Local/State Employment Exchange/Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD must apply only through the NAPS/NATS portal.
  • The apprenticeship period is 12 months for all disciplines. On completion, IOCL has no obligation to offer regular employment, and apprentices cannot claim employment rights on the grounds of completing the apprenticeship. Ex-apprentices get an equal opportunity to apply for future openings like any other candidate.
  • Candidature is provisional and subject to verification; any false/incorrect/suppressed information detected at any stage - even after engagement - can lead to cancellation or termination.
  • Engagement is subject to being declared medically fit as per Corporation requirements and all relevant rules/policies/guidelines.
  • The decision of the management is final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, selection, and cancellation of the process; filling of seats is entirely at the discretion of management, and no claim will arise if seats remain unfilled.
  • Incomplete applications, applications in any other mode, or those received after the last date will be treated as rejected. Canvassing of any kind will disqualify the candidate.

Eligibility Criteria for CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates planning to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Bharti 2026 must meet all eligibility conditions set by CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd. The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and no upper age limit is mentioned in the official notification. Candidates must hold a valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized testing and certifying agency.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have one of the following qualifications to be eligible for the CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026:

Qualification Option Details
Option 1 12th Pass (Intermediate / Senior Secondary)
Option 2 Matriculation + 2 Years ITI
Option 3 Matriculation + 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma

Age Limit

The minimum age to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator Vacancy 2026 is 18 years. No maximum age or age relaxation details are mentioned in the official notification.

Mandatory Certificate Requirement

Every applicant must possess an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar services. Additionally, candidates must have basic computer skills. Candidates who do not yet hold this certificate can appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the link: https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action

Who is NOT Eligible

As per the official notification, VLEs (Village Level Entrepreneurs) are not eligible to apply for the Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District post under this CSC recruitment drive.

Salary / Remuneration - CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator 2026

Selected candidates under the CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026 will be paid as per the state government's prescribed wage structure. The remuneration for all selected Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator candidates will be the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower. 

How to Obtain the Aadhaar Supervisor Certificate Before Applying

Candidates who do not yet hold the mandatory Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate need to complete two steps before they are eligible to apply for CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra jobs. First, they must apply for and pass the Aadhaar Supervisor exam; second, they must complete the LMS certification. Both processes are managed through official UIDAI platforms.

  1. Visit the Aadhaar Supervisor exam portal at https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action and submit your exam application.
  2. An authorization request will be sent to the State Team. Once approved, you will be permitted to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam.
  3. After your LMS ID and Password are created and approved, appear for the Aadhaar LMS Certification through the portal at https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in
  4. Once certified, proceed to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor district post on the CSC Job Portal.

How to Apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026

The CSC Aadhaar Operator Apply Online 2026 process is conducted entirely through the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in. Candidates must ensure they have their Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate ready before beginning the application. The last date to apply is 31 August 2026, and no offline applications are accepted under this recruitment.

  1. Visit the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in.
  2. Navigate to the relevant job post for your state - Tamil Nadu, Jharkhand, Delhi, Uttarakhand, Puducherry, Rajasthan
  3. Click on the "Apply Now" button on the job post page.
  4. Fill in the online application form with your personal, educational, and certification details.
  5. Upload the required documents including your Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate.
  6. Submit the application form before 31 August 2026.

Common Mistakes to Avoid in CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Many candidates make avoidable errors while applying for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Vacancy 2026 that can lead to rejection of their application. The points below are based on common patterns seen in similar contractual government recruitment drives and are not derived from the official notification.

  1. Applying without a valid UIDAI certificate: The Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized agency is a mandatory requirement. Applying without it will result in disqualification.
  2. VLEs applying despite ineligibility: VLEs are explicitly barred from applying. Submitting an application as a VLE wastes your time and will be rejected at the verification stage.
  3. Applying for the wrong district: Each vacancy is district-specific. Ensure you apply for the correct district as per your location and preference.
  4. Incomplete LMS Certification: Candidates sometimes have the Supervisor exam cleared but not the LMS Certification. Both are required before applying.
  5. Submitting incorrect documents: Upload clear, legible scans of your educational certificates and Aadhaar Operator certificate. Blurry or mismatched documents can cause rejection.
  6. Missing the last date: The portal closes applications on 31 August 2026. Do not wait until the last day — technical issues near the deadline are common.
  7. Confusing CSC e-Governance with state government jobs: This is a contractual, not permanent government post. Ensure you understand the terms of engagement before applying.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

There is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts. Selection is merit-based on academic qualifications. For Supervisor and CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted.

How to Apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Online

  • Visit the official portal: Go to your state's official WCD / ICDS website or the direct link provided in the vacancy table above. For central information, visit wcd.nic.in.
  • Find the recruitment notification: Click on the "Recruitment" or "Anganwadi Recruitment 2026" section.
  • Download and read the notification: Download and read the official notification PDF carefully before applying.
  • Register / Login: Create a new account using your mobile number and Aadhaar. If already registered, log in with your credentials.
  • Fill the application form: Enter personal details, educational qualification, address, and select your preferred district/ward. Ensure you apply only for a ward where you are a permanent resident.
  • Upload documents: Upload scanned copies of your passport-size photograph, signature, 10th/12th marksheet, Aadhaar card, and any caste/domicile certificate if required.
  • Review and submit: Check all entries carefully before final submission. Download and print the application confirmation / acknowledgement slip for your records.

Documents Required for Anganwadi Application

  • Aadhaar Card (Mandatory)
  • 10th Marksheet & Certificate
  • 12th Marksheet (for AWW)
  • Graduation Certificate (Supervisor)
  • Domicile / Residence Certificate
  • Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC)
  • Passport-size Photograph
  • Signature (scanned)
  • EWS Certificate (if applicable)
  • PwD Certificate (if applicable)

About this page: Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 information is compiled by the OnlyJobs editorial team directly from official state WCD / ICDS recruitment notifications. We verify all vacancy details, eligibility, and last dates before publishing. Page is updated daily as new notifications are released. For any discrepancy, always refer to the official notification PDF linked in the apply column above.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) Notification 2026 has been released on the official website upsconline.nic.in/ora. A total of 80 vacancies have been announced through the UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026.

Candidates aged up to 35 years for UR/EWS, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC/ST who have a degree from a recognised university or equivalent are eligible to apply for these Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner vacancies. The online application process for UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026 will start on 22 August 2026 and will remain open until 11 September 2026 up to 1800 hrs.

Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has officially released Special Advertisement No. 52/2026 for recruitment by selection to 80 posts of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) in the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Ministry of Labour & Employment. The notification includes complete details on category-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limit, application fee, Recruitment Test, interview, syllabus, salary, and online application procedure. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification carefully before applying. The notification is available on the official UPSC online application website.

  • Download UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF
  • Apply Online Link
  • Official Website

UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026 Overview

The full name of the recruiting body is the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), commonly referred to as UPSC. This notification, published as Special Advertisement No. 52/2026, covers recruitment by selection to the post of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) under the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), which functions under the Ministry of Labour & Employment. The table below summarises the key details of UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026.

Particulars Details
Recruiting Body Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
Advertisement No. Special Advertisement No. 52/2026
Post Name Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC)
Vacancy No. 26085201722
Recruiting Organisation for the Post Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Ministry of Labour & Employment
Total Vacancies 80 (Eighty)
Mode of Application Online, via upsconline.nic.in/ora
Application Start Date 22 August 2026
Application Last Date 11 September 2026 (1800 hrs)
Selection Process Recruitment Test (RT) followed by Interview
Job Location Headquarters: New Delhi (All India Service liability)
Official Website upsconline.nic.in/ora

UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Candidates planning to apply for UPSC APFC Vacancy 2026 should note the following schedule.

Event Date
Start of Online Application 22 August 2026
Last Date to Apply Online 11 September 2026, up to 1800 hrs
Recruitment Test (RT) Date 20 December 2026
Interview Date To be intimated separately to shortlisted candidates

The prescribed closing date for submission of the online application is also the date for determining candidates' eligibility in every respect.

UPSC APFC Vacancy 2026 Details

A total of 80 vacancies are notified for the post of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner. The category-wise break-up is given below.

Category Number of Vacancies
Unreserved (UR) 29
Economically Weaker Section (EWS) 08
Other Backward Classes (OBC) 18
Scheduled Caste (SC) 15
Scheduled Tribe (ST) 10
Total 80
Of which, reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) 03

Of the 80 posts, three vacancies are reserved for candidates with benchmark disability (PwBD), covering categories such as blindness and low vision, deaf and hard of hearing, and specified locomotor disabilities, as detailed in the official notification.

UPSC APFC Eligibility Criteria

UPSC APFC Qualification

Essential Qualification: A degree of a recognised university or equivalent.

Desirable Qualification: A diploma in Company Law, Labour Laws, or Public Administration.

The Commission may relax these qualifications at its discretion for otherwise well-qualified candidates, and the notification specifies criteria the Commission may use for shortlisting if the number of applications is large, including preference for desirable qualifications or relevant experience.

UPSC APFC Age Limit

Category Upper Age Limit
UR / EWS 35 years
OBC 38 years
SC / ST 40 years
PwBD Age relaxable up to 10 years, subject to a maximum age limit of 56 years

Additional age relaxation is available for Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers, Central/UT Government employees, and EPFO employees (up to 5 years), as per the concessions listed in the official notification.

UPSC APFC Application Fee

Category Application Fee
General / EWS / OBC (Male) Rs. 25
Female / SC / ST / PwBD (any community) Exempted (No Fee)

Fee can be paid online using a Visa/Master/RuPay Credit or Debit Card, UPI, or internet banking. The fee, once paid, is not refunded or carried forward to any other examination.

UPSC APFC Salary

The post of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner carries Level-10 in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC). The post is permanent and classified as Central Board Group "A", Non-Ministerial, equivalent to Group-A of the Central Government at the corresponding pay level. The probation period is one year, and the post carries All India Service liability, meaning selected officers may be required to serve anywhere in India.

UPSC APFC Selection Process

Selection to the post of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner is made through a Recruitment Test (RT) followed by a Personality Test/Interview.

Stage Details
Recruitment Test (RT) Objective type (multiple choice), 2 hours duration, conducted in English and Hindi, carrying 300 marks. Wrong answers attract a penalty of one-third of the marks assigned to that question.
Interview Carries 100 marks
Weightage (RT : Interview) 75 : 25
Minimum Qualifying Marks in Interview General/EWS: 50 and above; OBC: 45 and above; SC/ST/PwBD: 40 and above (out of 100)

The syllabus for the Recruitment Test broadly covers General English, Indian Culture and Heritage, developmental issues and the Indian economy, governance and the Constitution of India, general science and computer applications, elementary mathematics, statistics and mental ability, industrial relations and labour codes, principles of accountancy, auditing and insurance, and current events of national and international importance.

The Recruitment Test will be held at 84 designated centres across India, including cities such as Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Lucknow, with the full list published in the official notification. Centre allotment follows a first-apply-first-allot basis, subject to a ceiling on candidates per centre (except Chennai, Dispur, Kolkata, and Nagpur).

How to Apply for UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026

UPSC APFC Apply Online

Candidates must apply online through the Commission's website, upsconline.nic.in/ora. The portal has four modules: Account Creation, Universal Registration, and the Common Application Form (CAF), which are common to all UPSC recruitments, plus a fourth, post-specific module for this vacancy.

  1. Create an account and complete the Universal Registration on the portal to receive a Universal Registration Number (URN).
  2. Fill in the Common Application Form (CAF) with personal, educational, and category details, and upload a photograph along with a live photo capture.
  3. Upload a signature signed three times on plain white paper, as per the prescribed format.
  4. Complete the post/vacancy-specific module for Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner within the application window.
  5. Upload supporting documents (proof of date of birth, educational qualification, category certificate, disability certificate, etc.) as applicable.
  6. Pay the application fee online, if applicable, and submit the form before the closing date.
  7. Take a printout of the finally submitted application for future reference.

Applications cannot be withdrawn, and no correction or alteration is allowed after final submission. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance rather than waiting for the closing date.

Important Instructions

  • A candidate must be a citizen of India, or fall under the specific categories of Nepal/Bhutan subjects, Tibetan refugees, or persons of Indian origin migrated from certain countries, as defined in the notification.
  • All correspondence from the Commission will be made through the registered e-mail ID, so candidates must provide a correct and active e-mail address.
  • Persons already in regular Government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department of their application.
  • Mobile phones and other electronic/communication devices are strictly banned inside the examination/interview venue.
  • Candidates will undergo mandatory face authentication at the examination venue/interview hall.
  • Furnishing false particulars or suppressing material information can lead to rejection of candidature and debarment from future examinations or Government employment.
  • Candidates are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card as the ID document for verification.

Candidates up to 29 years for GEN/EWS, 32 years for OBC and 34 years for SC/ST who have a 3-year full-time Polytechnic Engineering Diploma in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Instrumentation, Industrial Electronics, or Mechatronics with at least 60% marks are eligible to apply for these Non Executive vacancies. BEML Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification and age limit criteria mentioned below as on 8th September 2026.

BEML Non Executive Educational Qualification

  • 3-year full-time Polytechnic Engineering Diploma in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Instrumentation, Industrial Electronics, or Mechatronics.
  • The diploma must be a regular course from an AICTE/DCTE-approved College/Institution.
  • Candidates must have secured a First Class with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks.
  • A relaxation of 5% in the minimum qualifying marks is available for SC/ST/PwD candidates.

GEN/EWS 29 years

OBC 32 years

  • OBC candidates: 3 years relaxation
  • PwD candidates: an additional 10 years over and above the relaxation admissible for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), applicable to candidates with a minimum of 40% disability

Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

BEML Recruitment 2026 Salary Structure

Selected candidates will be engaged on tenure basis and paid the following monthly consolidated remuneration:

Pay Component Amount / Rate
Basic Pay Rs. 23,910/- per month
Dearness Allowance (DA) At applicable rates (currently 55.7%)
House Rent Allowance (HRA) X Class city: 30%, Y Class city: 20%, Z Class city: 10% (applicable only if Company Quarters is not provided)
Medical Expenses Rs. 1,500/- per month

An annual increase of 3% on the Basic Pay is admissible during the tenure, subject to satisfactory performance. Provident Fund is calculated on Basic Pay + DA. Candidates will also be eligible for Gratuity (as per the Gratuity Scheme) and Bonus (as per the Bonus Act), and are covered under applicable Income Tax, Service Tax, and Professional Tax rules.

Category Application Fee

How to Apply Online for BEML Recruitment 2026?

Interested and eligible candidates can apply only through the online mode on the official BEML career page. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official BEML website: www.bemlindia.in.
  2. Go to the Careers section and locate the notification for Draft Advt No. KP/S/14/2026.
  3. Read the detailed advertisement carefully before proceeding.
  4. Register using a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, and ensure both remain active for at least one year.
  5. Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and category details.
  6. Upload all required documents as per the checklist mentioned in the notification.
  7. Pay the applicable non-refundable application fee (if applicable to your category).
  8. Submit the form and note down the Registration Number generated for future correspondence.

The online registration will remain open till 18:00 Hrs on 8th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they apply well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical issues.

BEML Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for the Non Executive (Tenure Basis) post will be based on the following process:

Written Test Pattern

Part Subject No. of Questions
Part-I General Awareness 20
Part-II English & Reasoning 20
Part-III Concerned Discipline 60
  • The Computer Based Test will be of 2 hours duration, with 1 mark for each correct answer and no negative marking.
  • The qualifying marks for the written test are fixed at 60%, relaxable by 5% for SC/ST/PwD candidates.
  • Final selection is based purely on merit (marks scored) in the written test.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification, limited to the number of notified vacancies (discipline/category-wise).
  • Candidates qualifying in Document Verification must undergo a Pre-Employment Medical Examination.
  • A Provisional Offer is issued after Document Verification, followed by a Final Offer of Engagement after a satisfactory Medical Report.

Candidates qualifying for Document Verification will be reimbursed Travelling Allowance (Sleeper Class/II Class train fare or bus fare by the shortest route), subject to production of proof of journey.

Documents Required for BEML Recruitment 2026

1 Recent photograph
2 Signature on a clear white background in black ink
3 Latest Caste/Category Certificate (as applicable)
4 PwD Certificate (as applicable)
5 10th Standard Marks Card

Applications submitted without the mandatory documents listed above will be summarily rejected.

BEML Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • SC/ST candidates must submit a Caste Certificate in the Government of India format.
  • OBC candidates must submit a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate not older than six months as on the last date of application, along with a self-undertaking.
  • PwD candidates must submit a PwD Certificate in the prescribed format.
  • EWS candidates must submit an Income & Assets Certificate in the applicable format.
  • Any request for change in category, address, e-mail, mobile number, or test centre location, once declared in the online application, will not be entertained.
  • Merely meeting the eligibility conditions does not automatically entitle a candidate to appointment.
  • BEML reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates, change the qualifying percentage, increase/decrease vacancies, or cancel the recruitment process at its discretion.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a maximum tenure of four years, terminable by either party with one month's notice or pay in lieu of notice.
  • Candidates are advised to beware of fraudulent agencies; the recruitment process is handled solely by BEML's Recruitment Cell.
  • For queries, candidates may e-mail [email protected].
  • Any Corrigendum/Addendum will be published on the official BEML website.

The notification does not specify a separate admit card or interview date; shortlisted candidates will be intimated individually about the interview venue and time through the email ID given in their application.

HUDCO Executive Vacancy Details 2026

HUDCO has released 08 vacancies across two disciplines - Projects and Finance - for lateral-level executive posts.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Deputy General Manager (E-5) - Projects Discipline 01 (01 OBC-NCL)
2 Assistant General Manager (E-4) - Projects Discipline 01 (01 OBC-NCL)
3 Deputy General Manager (E-5) - Finance Discipline 03 (02 UR, 01 SC)
4 Senior Manager (E-3) - Finance Discipline 03 (01 UR, 01 SC, 01 EWS)

Discipline-wise, the Projects Discipline has 02 vacancies and the Finance Discipline has 06 vacancies, taking the total to 08 posts.

HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for HUDCO Recruitment 2026 is based on educational qualification, post-qualification executive experience, and age limit, as detailed below.

HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Qualification

Post Qualification Specifications Min. Post-Qualification Experience / CTC
Deputy General Manager (E-5) - Projects Bachelor's degree in Civil/Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Mechanical engineering or equivalent, with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/grade. Desirable: MBA/Two years' PG Diploma with Finance specialization. 11 years / CTC of ₹27.46 lakh p.a.
Assistant General Manager (E-4) - Projects Same qualification as above 07 years / CTC of ₹22.79 lakh p.a.
Deputy General Manager (E-5) - Finance CA/CMA, or Two years' full-time MBA/PG Diploma with Finance specialization, with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/grade (except in case of CA/CMA) 11 years / CTC of ₹27.46 lakh p.a.
Senior Manager (E-3) - Finance Same qualification as above 05 years / CTC of ₹18.99 lakh p.a.

Candidates should also possess relevant work experience: Projects Discipline candidates need hands-on experience in project appraisal, financial modelling, project development, project management, project monitoring, and regulatory compliance for Government, Private, or PPP infrastructure projects. Finance Discipline candidates need experience in financial management, budgeting, accounts, taxation, banking, credit appraisal, loan and recovery management, risk management, ERP implementation, and regulatory compliance.

Experience is calculated from the date of acquiring the essential educational qualification. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in Scheduled Commercial Banks, NBFCs (including IFCs), multilateral organizations, or other financial institutions.

HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

Post Maximum Age Limit
Deputy General Manager (E-5) - Projects & Finance 45 years
Assistant General Manager (E-4) - Projects 40 years
Senior Manager (E-3) - Finance 35 years

Age will be reckoned as on 01.08.2026. Age relaxation is permissible up to 05 years for SC/ST candidates and 03 years for OBC(NCL) candidates. Age relaxation for Ex-Servicemen will be as per applicable Government norms.

Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Salary

HUDCO offers pay on the IDA pay-scale (w.e.f. 01.01.2017), along with an approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC) for each level.

Level IDA Pay-scale Minimum Basic Pay (per month) Approximate Annual CTC
E-5 (Deputy General Manager) ₹80,000-2,20,000 ₹80,000 ₹30.47 lakhs
E-4 (Assistant General Manager) ₹70,000-2,00,000 ₹70,000 ₹26.66 lakhs
E-3 (Senior Manager) ₹60,000-1,80,000 ₹60,000 ₹22.13 lakhs

The CTC includes minimum Basic Pay, Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) at 55.7% of basic pay, HRA (30% of basic pay), Perks & Allowances (35% of basic pay), superannuation benefits (30% of basic pay), and Performance Related Pay (PRP) at maximum potential as per DPE slabs. In addition, employees get conveyance, company-leased accommodation (in lieu of HRA), medical reimbursement, loans and advances, group insurance, and other social security/functional benefits. Actual PRP payout depends on individual, team, and company performance, and IDA rates may change as notified by the Ministry of Finance.

HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Category Application Fee
UR / EWS / OBC-NCL ₹1,500
SC / ST / PwBD Exempted (Nil)

The application fee is not refundable under any circumstances. HUDCO is not responsible for non-submission of an application due to delayed, failed, or truncated payments, payment to the wrong bank account, multiple payment attempts, or technical issues during submission. Candidates are advised to retain the original payment receipt or transaction reference for future verification.

HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for HUDCO Executive Recruitment 2026 is based solely on performance in a personal Interview; there is no written examination specified in the notification.

  • Applications are first scrutinised for eligibility with respect to age, post-qualification experience, current pay level, and other notified criteria.
  • Only prima-facie eligible applications are shortlisted for interview, generally in a ratio of 1:15 (subject to availability). If applications for a post are high, HUDCO may apply a higher shortlisting criterion than the specified minimum eligibility.
  • Document verification is done before the interview; shortlisted candidates must bring all original certificates.
  • The interview carries a total of 100 marks, split as: Job Knowledge (50 marks), Quality and nature of work experience (20 marks), and Overall personality (30 marks).
  • Minimum qualifying marks in the interview: 70 marks for UR/EWS category, 60 marks for OBC-NCL category, and 50 marks for SC/ST category.
  • Candidates can appear for the interview in Hindi or English.

If no communication is received from HUDCO within 120 days from the date of the advertisement, candidates may presume their candidature has not been considered further.

Documents Required for HUDCO Recruitment 2026

Candidates should keep the following documents ready at the time of application, as specified in the notification:

  • Duly filled-in candidate format (available on the HUDCO website)
  • Proof of Date of Birth (SSC/Tenth Class/Matriculation Certificate)
  • Caste/category certificate, where applicable (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/Ex-Servicemen)
  • Disability certificate from a prescribed competent authority, where applicable, indicating type and percentage of disability
  • Documents related to essential qualification (final degree certificate, mark sheets, CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula if applicable)
  • Documents related to any additional qualifications
  • A detailed write-up (not more than one page) on past work experience
  • Experience certificate/relieving letter from past organisation(s) stating period of employment and nature of work
  • Proof of pay-scale/CTC of current employer for the preceding one year, or payslips of the preceding 12 months if a CTC document is unavailable

All documents should be self-attested, and applications with poor-quality, illegible, incomplete, or discrepant documents are liable to be rejected.

How to Apply for HUDCO Recruitment 2026

HUDCO Recruitment 2026 applications must be submitted online; applications through any other mode will not be accepted.

  1. Visit the official HUDCO website at www.hudco.org.in.
  2. Go to the 'Careers' tab, where detailed instructions on the online application process are uploaded.
  3. Read the notification carefully and fill in the online application form with accurate details.
  4. Upload the required documents as specified in the notification.
  5. Pay the applicable application fee online, if applicable to your category.
  6. Submit the application before the last date and retain the payment receipt/transaction reference.

Candidates eligible for and wishing to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application with a separate fee for each post; in case of multiple/duplicate applications for the same post, only the latest application will be considered.

HUDCO Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • No posts are reserved for PwBD category, though PwBD candidates may apply if their disability is identified for the relevant post/discipline.
  • Qualifications must be from a University/Institute recognised by the Government of India and approved by the UGC or the appropriate statutory authority. Distance learning/part-time qualifications are also accepted if recognised by the appropriate statutory bodies.
  • Candidates from Government organisations/CPSEs/Public Sector Banks must have a minimum of one year's experience in the immediate lower pay-scale as on the cut-off date, held on a substantive basis.
  • Candidates from private organisations must have worked for a minimum of one year in a post with the specified CTC as on the cut-off date, and must submit annual CTC statements and payslips as proof.
  • Only regular/fixed-term/contractual employment on the rolls of a company is considered; employment through a third party/agency is not considered.
  • Outstation candidates attending the interview will be reimbursed single to-and-fro travel by the shortest route, restricted to actual fare or 2A AC rail fare, whichever is lower, subject to successful document verification.
  • Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere in the country; no request for choice of posting will be entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • All disputes related to this recruitment are subject to the jurisdiction of courts in Delhi only.
  • The posts advertised are tentative, and HUDCO reserves the right to cancel, restrict, modify, or alter the recruitment process without prior notice.

For queries related to filling up the application, candidates can contact the helpline number 011-24649610-15, extension 1168/1156/1153, on working days from 9:30 hrs to 18:00 hrs.

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), through the ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB), has released ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026 for 175 posts of Scientist/Engineer 'SC' in Electronics, Mechanical, and Computer Science disciplines. The notification, Advt No. ISRO:ICRB:03(EMC):2026 dated 27-08-2026, invites online applications from meritorious BE/B.Tech graduates for Group 'A' posts in Level 10 of the Pay Matrix at constituent ISRO Centres and at the autonomous body Physical Research Laboratory (PRL). Online registration is open from 27-08-2026 to 16-09-2026.

Quick answers: ISRO/Department of Space is recruiting for the post of Scientist/Engineer 'SC' across Electronics, Mechanical and Computer Science streams. A total of 175 vacancies are notified. Candidates with a BE/B.Tech (or equivalent) degree in the relevant discipline, with a minimum of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84/10, and aged up to 28 years as on 16-09-2026, can apply. Online applications open on 27-08-2026 and close on 16-09-2026 (11:55 PM), and applications are accepted only through the online mode on www.isro.gov.in. The posts are located at ISRO Centres across India and at PRL.

ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Eligibility Criteria and Qualification

Eligibility for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026 is assessed on educational qualification, nationality, and age as on 16-09-2026.

Post Required Qualification
Scientist/Engineer 'SC' (Electronics) BE/B.Tech or equivalent in Electronics & Communication Engineering with a minimum aggregate of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84/10
Scientist/Engineer 'SC' (Mechanical) BE/B.Tech or equivalent in Mechanical Engineering with a minimum aggregate of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84/10
Scientist/Engineer 'SC' (Computer Science) BE/B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science Engineering with a minimum aggregate of 65% marks or CGPA 6.84/10

The notification clarifies that graduation must be completed within the stipulated duration of the course as prescribed by the university. Allied disciplines acceptable under each stream are listed in the FAQs published on the ISRO website (not detailed in this notification). Where a university's certificate mentions both CGPA and percentage, at least one criterion must meet ISRO's eligibility norms; where only CGPA is mentioned, that CGPA itself must meet the norm, and conversion of CGPA to percentage is not permitted for determining eligibility (and vice versa where only percentage is mentioned). Separate rules for Dual/Integrated Degree programmes are also specified in the notification. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.

ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Selection Process

Selection for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026 is based on a Written Test/CBT followed by an Interview.

Written Test/CBT Pattern

Part Duration Question Type No. of Questions Marks Marking Scheme
Part A – Area/Discipline Specific 90 minutes Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) 80 80 +1 for each correct answer, 0 for unattempted, -1/3 for each wrong answer
Part B – Aptitude/Ability Test 30 minutes Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) on Numerical, Logical, Diagrammatic, Abstract, and Deductive Reasoning Maximum 15 20 No negative marking

The Written Test/CBT carries a total of 100 marks and will be conducted at 37 venues across India, including Agartala, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneshwar, Chandigarh/Mohali, Chennai, Dehradun, Delhi, Ernakulam, Gorakhpur, Gurugram, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Indore, Jaipur, Jammu, Jodhpur, Kanpur, Kavaratti, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mangaluru, Mumbai, Mysore, Nagpur, Patna, Port Blair, Pune, Raipur, Ranchi, Shillong, Tiruchirapalli, Thiruvananthapuram, Varanasi, Vijayawada, and Visakhapatnam. ICRB reserves the right to change or cancel a test venue and reallot candidates to another centre.

Qualifying Marks in Written Test/CBT

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
Unreserved candidates 50% each in Part A and Part B
PwBD candidates (wherever posts are reserved) 40% each in Part A and Part B

Based on Written Test/CBT performance, candidates will be shortlisted for interview in a 1:5 ratio, with an aggregate minimum of 10 candidates. For reserved vacancies, distinct/additional candidates are shortlisted separately in the 1:5 ratio.

For the final panel, 50% weightage is given to Written Test/CBT marks and 50% to Interview marks. In case of a tie, inter-se merit is decided in order by marks in the Written Test/CBT, marks in the essential qualification, and then date of birth (older candidates placed higher).

How to Apply for ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official ISRO website, www.isro.gov.in, between 27-08-2026 and 16-09-2026.
  2. Complete the online registration and note the online Registration Number provided after registration for future reference.
  3. Fill in the online application form, ensuring the e-mail ID is entered correctly and compulsorily, as hall tickets/call letters will be sent only by e-mail.
  4. Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph and signature in the specified format and size.
  5. Upload the SC/ST/Disability/Ex-Servicemen certificate, if applicable.
  6. Pay the processing fee of ₹750 online via the Bharatkosh e-payment gateway using Internet Banking, UPI, or a Domestic Debit Card.
  7. Verify all entered details carefully before final submission of the online application.

Applications are accepted only in online mode; incomplete applications or those not conforming to the notification requirements will not be entertained. Candidates should avoid submitting multiple applications for the same post — where duplicate applications are submitted, only the one against which the application fee has been received within the last date will be considered.

ISRO Scientist Engineer SC Important Instructions

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Appointees are liable to be posted at any Centre/Unit of the Department of Space/ISRO and may be transferred at any time based on need.
  • The number of vacancies notified is provisional; ISRO reserves the right to increase or decrease vacancies as required.
  • ICRB/ISRO reserves the absolute right not to fill the posts, without assigning any reason.
  • The posts are temporary but likely to continue.
  • Candidates attending the interview will be reimbursed second-class train fare by the shortest route from the city indicated in the online application to the interview venue; no TA is payable for the Written Test.
  • If any information furnished online is found false, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for interview and TA will not be paid.
  • Employed candidates must apply only with the knowledge and prior permission of their employer, and must submit an NOC at the time of interview; failure to submit the original NOC will result in the candidate not being permitted to appear for interview.
  • All further communication will be sent only through the candidate's registered e-mail ID or the ISRO website; candidates should check their e-mail regularly, including spam/junk folders.
  • Legal matters arising from this recruitment fall under Bangalore, Karnataka jurisdiction.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates are advised not to take cognizance of any fake offer of appointment for jobs in ISRO.
  • In case of any ambiguity between the Hindi and English versions of the notification, the English version will be treated as final.

Key Eligibility Conditions

  • No claim of an equivalent educational qualification other than what is advertised for a post will be entertained; RFCL's decision on admissibility of a qualification is final and binding.
  • The essential qualification must be completed full-time and regular with a minimum of 60% marks, except for CA/CMA. Qualifications acquired through Part-Time/Correspondence/Distance Learning/Online/Evening Classes render the candidate ineligible.
  • Candidates appearing in the final year/semester of the essential qualification, with results awaited as on the cut-off date, are NOT eligible to apply.
  • Work experience for all posts must be after acquiring the relevant educational qualification, and must be in-line executive experience. Management Trainee/GET experience counts only if regularized in the same company. Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 does not count as post-qualification experience. Experience with candidates working on contract basis through empaneled agencies/contractors will not be considered.
  • Candidates possessing higher technical/professional qualifications in the relevant field are also eligible, provided they possess the mandatory qualification listed above.
  • Where CGPA/OGPA or a letter grade is awarded instead of a percentage, candidates must produce the University/Institute's official conversion formula; in its absence, a standard conversion table is used (e.g., 6.5 on a 10-point scale = 60%).
  • Computer literacy is desirable for all candidates.
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Government/Quasi-Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview, or submit an undertaking to produce a relieving order if selected - failing which they will not be allowed to join; no Service Transfer/Pay Protection will apply without an NOC at joining.
  • Preference will be given to candidates with in-line executive experience in the Chemical and Fertilizer Industry.

RFCL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Scrutiny of applications will be done based on the information and documents submitted; eligible candidates will be provisionally shortlisted and called for a Personal Interview. The shortlist will be placed on the RFCL website under "Careers."
  • If a large number of applications are received, RFCL may conduct a Computer-Based Test in Delhi-NCR and/or other cities for shortlisting candidates for interview. No TA, or Boarding & Lodging, will be paid/arranged for appearing in this test. Test modalities, if conducted, will be published on the RFCL website.
  • Candidates must qualify the Personal Interview with a minimum average of 50% marks.
  • Tie-breaker for equal total marks: percentage of marks in the qualifying examination; if still equal, the candidate with the earlier date of birth is considered senior in the merit list.
  • Candidates not meeting eligibility criteria, or without complete requisite documents, will not be allowed to attend the interview, and no TA will be paid.
  • Travel Reimbursement for Interview: Candidates called for interview at level E-5 to E-8 are reimbursed single return air fare (economy class)/AC I rail fare/Executive class chair car/road mileage at prescribed rates. Candidates for E-1 to E-4 posts are reimbursed to-and-fro single AC II return rail fare from the nearest railway station of their correspondence address to the interview venue, by the shortest route, on production of documents/receipts.
  • Candidature is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of Degree certificates/testimonials, Caste/PwBD/ExSM status. Candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage if the candidate does not meet the advertised eligibility criteria, irrespective of merit position.
  • No candidate will be appointed unless medically examined, certified, and declared fit for employment by the Company's Medical Officer or a Medical Officer not below the rank of Civil Surgeon/CMO/Medical Superintendent of a State/Government Hospital.

How to Apply for RFCL Recruitment 2026

  1. Eligible and interested candidates should apply online from 26 August 2026 (08:00 hrs) to 24 September 2026 (17:00 hrs) on the RFCL website: www.rfcl.co.in → Careers.
  2. Only one application per candidate per post is allowed. Details can be edited before final submission, but cannot be changed once the online form is finally submitted - fill in carefully.
  3. After successful online submission, take a printout of the application form.
  4. Send the printed application, along with self-attested copies of all requisite supporting documents (educational qualifications, experience certificates, caste certificate, PwBD certificate, etc.), in a sealed envelope superscribed:
    "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF …………………………… IN RFCL - 01/2026"
  5. Post the sealed envelope to:
    Dy. General Manager (HR), Ramagundam Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited, Corporate Office, 4th Floor, Wing – A, Kribhco Bhawan, Sector-1, Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201301
  6. Ensure the hard copy reaches RFCL by 1 October 2026 (or 8 October 2026 for candidates from notified far-flung areas, with "FAR-FLUNG AREA" superscribed on the envelope).

Incomplete application forms, forms not supported by self-attested documents, forms not fulfilling eligibility criteria, forms received at any other RFCL address, or forms received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

RFCL Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • 10th/Matriculation certificate is the authentic document for verifying date of birth.
  • Details submitted in the online application (including correspondence address, email, mobile number, and category) are final; no change request will be entertained after submission.
  • Category (Gen/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PwBD) once submitted cannot be changed, and no benefit of a different category will be admissible later.
  • Reserved category candidates must submit a copy of their Caste/PwBD certificate (in the Government-prescribed proforma, issued by a Competent Authority) along with the online application form; a self-certified translated copy is required if the original is not in English/Hindi.
  • Only OBC communities in the Central Government's common OBC list are treated as OBC; OBC(NCL) candidates must submit the latest Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the prescribed proforma and give a self-declaration at the interview. OBC candidates in the creamy layer are treated as Unreserved.
  • PwBD reservation is applied on a horizontal inter-locking basis; PwBD candidates are considered only against identified positions and must submit a Disability Certificate (as per the Persons with Disabilities Amended Rules, 2009) - a "person with benchmark disability" per Section 2(r) of the RPwD Act, 2016 must have not less than 40% disability.
  • Mere possession of the essential qualification does not entitle a candidate to participate in the selection process; RFCL's decision on eligibility, shortlisting, and selection is final and binding.
  • Shortlisted candidates must bring original certificates at the interview; failing this, they may not be allowed to appear, and no TA will be paid.
  • Furnishing false/incorrect/incomplete information, suppressing material facts, using unfair means, or impersonation renders a candidate ineligible; candidature/appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated at any stage, even during employment.
  • Candidates should keep their registered email ID and mobile number active for at least 1.5 years from the cut-off date, as all communication will be via email/SMS/website upload; no change of email ID is allowed once submitted.
  • Retain a copy of the Application Form and Fee receipt for future reference.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum/errata will be published only on the RFCL website (www.rfcl.co.in → Careers); no further press advertisement will be issued.
  • Issues related to form fill-up or fee payment may be emailed to: [email protected]
  • In case of any ambiguity in versions other than English, the English version on the RFCL website shall prevail.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • The court of jurisdiction for any dispute arising from this recruitment process is New Delhi only, to the exclusion of all other courts.

SECI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

SECI reserves the right to revise the eligibility criteria upward, or limit the number of applications called for a post, based on marks obtained in Graduation/Post-Graduation/Diploma or years of relevant experience. Depending on the number of applications received, SECI may conduct a screening test, written test, trade test, or skill test, as deemed fit. Only shortlisted candidates found eligible based on the notified specifications will be called for a Written Test/Group Discussion/Interview. Mere possession of the minimum prescribed qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for the next stage. The selection process stages will be updated on the SECI website's Careers section, and candidates are advised to check it periodically.

How to Apply for SECI Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official SECI website: www.seci.co.in.
  2. Go to the Careers section and locate Notification No. 03/2026 for Recruitment of Experienced Professionals.
  3. Register with a valid e-mail ID and complete the online application form.
  4. Upload a passport-size photograph and signature in the specified format (JPG/JPEG, 20 KB to 50 KB).
  5. Upload category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD), if applicable, in the specified size (100 KB to 300 KB).
  6. Upload educational mark sheets/certificates and post-qualification experience certificates (offer/appointment letter, experience certificate, last 3 months' pay slips, Form-16, joining/relieving order, etc.).
  7. Pay the applicable application fee online, where applicable.
  8. Review and submit the application before the closing date: 23.09.2026 (5 PM).

Applications sent through any mode other than the prescribed online mode will stand rejected. Incomplete applications, or those submitted with blurred/faded documents, will be summarily rejected.

SECI Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • A candidate may apply for more than one position if eligible, but must submit a separate application for each post.
  • Candidates employed in Government departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies must forward their application through proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the interview stage.
  • Teaching experience will not be counted towards post-qualification experience.
  • All appointments are subject to medical fitness as per Company rules.
  • Selected candidates are liable to be posted at any Unit/Area/Project under SECI's control in different States or locations.
  • Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Delhi Court only.
  • Candidates previously removed/terminated/who deserted employment from SECI will not be considered.
  • Any further addendum/corrigendum/update will be published only on www.seci.co.in under the Careers section.

Candidates up to 40 years of age who have a full-time Diploma or Degree in Mechanical/Metallurgical Engineering along with a valid UT Level-2 Certificate (ASNT/ISNT) and the prescribed post-qualification experience are eligible to apply for these Engineer vacancies. The online application process for RITES Engineer Recruitment 2026 has started on 21 August 2026 and will remain open until 14 September 2026.

Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.
