The notification includes complete details on category-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, UT Level-2 certification, post-qualification experience, age limit, salary, selection process, interview schedule, required documents, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification before applying. The notification is available on the official RITES website.

RITES Engineer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Candidates applying for the post of Engineer (VC No. CL/08/26) must possess any one of the following:

  • Full-time Diploma in Mechanical/Metallurgical branch of Engineering with UT Level-2 Certificate (ASNT/ISNT), or
  • Full-time Degree in Mechanical/Metallurgical branch of Engineering with UT Level-2 Certificate (ASNT/ISNT)

The Diploma/Degree must be from an institution recognised by BTE/AICTE, or from a university incorporated by an Act of Central or State legislature in India, or from an institution established/deemed under the University Grants Commission Act, 1956. Sections A & B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India), treated as equivalent to a Degree and recognised by AICTE, are also accepted.

Candidates from UR/EWS category (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates applying against unreserved posts) must have a first-class degree or a minimum of 60% marks. Reserved category candidates applying against reserved posts must have at least 50% marks. Where the certificate or marksheet does not show a class/division or percentage, candidates must submit the CGPA/DGPA conversion formula issued by their university; where no such formula exists, an authorised undertaking is required, with a minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale considered equivalent to 60%.

Experience Requirement

  • For Diploma holders: Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience
  • For Degree holders: Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience

Preference will be given to candidates possessing NDT experience. The period of training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic work, fellowship, or PhD research experience will not be counted towards the required experience.

Age Limit

Maximum Age Cut-off Date for Age Calculation
40 years As on the last date of application, i.e. 14.09.2026

Age Relaxation:

  • SC/ST category: 5 years
  • OBC-NCL category: 3 years
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 10 years, in addition to any age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates, subject to the post being identified as suitable for PWD

PwBD candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the 10-year age relaxation, subject to meeting the identified physical requirements and functional classifications for the post (locomotor disability category, as specified in the official notification).

How to Apply Online for RITES Engineer Recruitment 2026?

  1. Before applying, ensure you satisfy the eligibility conditions and requirements for the post.
  2. Visit the Career Section of the RITES website, www.rites.com, and apply online in the prescribed registration format.
  3. Note down the Registration Number generated on the online form after submission, and quote it in all further communication with RITES Ltd.
  4. Carefully fill in the Identity Proof details and ensure the same document will be available for verification later, if called.
  5. Upload all required documents under the "Upload Document" section of the application form.
  6. Make the online payment under the "Make Payment" section and download the final application form after successful payment.

Applications without successful fee payment will be treated as incomplete and summarily rejected. Hard copies of documents should not be sent to RITES by post or courier.

RITES Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Documents Required

Candidates must upload the following documents during the online application:

  • High School certificate as proof of Date of Birth
  • Certificates and mark sheets of all semesters/years for all claimed qualifications (Xth, XIIth, Diploma/Graduation/Post-Graduation)
  • Percentage Conversion Document issued by the University/Institute (wherever applicable)
  • EWS/SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD Certificate in the prescribed Government of India format (wherever applicable)
  • Proof of Identity and Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Aadhaar Card, etc.)
  • PAN Card
  • Proof of each period of claimed experience (offer letter, joining order, relieving letter, service certificate, relevant pay slips) submitted as a single PDF in chronological order
  • Any other document required in support of candidature and claims made in the application form

Candidates must ensure scanned copies are clear and visible; failure to upload the necessary documents can lead to cancellation of candidature. At the time of document verification/interview, self-attested photocopies of these documents (in a specified order, along with a recent passport-size colour photograph) must be produced, along with two duly filled copies of Annexure-A (Documents Submission Checklist).

RITES Engineer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process consists of the following stages:

  1. Document Scrutiny/Verification: All candidates who successfully submit the online application are provisionally allowed to appear for document scrutiny to verify their eligibility for the applied post.
  2. Interview: Shortlisted/eligible candidates are called for an interview, which carries a weightage of 100% - split as Technical & Professional proficiency (65%) and Personality, Communication & Competency (35%).

A minimum of 60% marks in the interview is required for UR/EWS candidates (50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates against reserved posts) to be considered for placement on the panel; there is no separate minimum qualifying mark in the aggregate. RITES Ltd. reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates for interview out of the eligible pool, and may conduct the written test, document verification, or interview from its Regional Offices as per requirement. Candidates may opt to appear for the interview in Hindi or English. Selected candidates must also be found medically fit as per RITES' Standards of Medical Fitness before final appointment.

  • The date of declaration of result must be mentioned in the marksheet; if not, a supporting certificate from the college/university is required
  • The percentage of marks in the final examination must be mentioned in the final/consolidated marksheet, or a Percentage Conversion Letter must be submitted
  • The required area of specialization must be mentioned in the certificate, or a supporting letter from the institute is required

Candidates are NOT eligible to apply if they:

  • Are awaiting the results of their final examination
  • Have not completed 18 years of age
  • Have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training in any organization, for any duration

POWERGRID Apprentice Salary 2026

Apprenticeship Trade Monthly Stipend

Diploma (Civil) ₹15,000 (including DBT of ₹5,450)
Diploma (Electrical) ₹15,000 (including DBT of ₹5,450)
Graduate (Electrical) ₹17,500 (including DBT of ₹6,150)
Graduate (Civil) ₹17,500 (including DBT of ₹6,150)
  • An additional ₹2,500 per month is payable if company accommodation is not provided or availed
  • The DBT portion is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme, subject to an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account
  • Apprentices are entitled to 12 days of Casual Leave (pro-rata) and 15 days of Medical Leave for the one-year duration, across all regions

POWERGRID Apprentice Application Fee

There is no application fee for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026 in any of the 10 regions. None of the notifications require a written examination or interview.

POWERGRID Apprentice Selection Process

  • Applications are screened in merit order based on eligibility criteria and the qualification prescribed for each trade, region-wise
  • Incomplete or ineligible applications are summarily rejected without intimation
  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD is applied as per the Apprentices Act, 1961
  • Candidates are called for document verification in a ratio of 1:5 against the notified training slots, in merit order
  • Shortlisted candidates are informed through their registered email; no TA/DA is paid for attending document verification
  • A final merit list is prepared from candidates found suitable after document verification
  • Selected candidates must accept a tripartite apprenticeship contract on the NATS/NAPS portal and submit a medical certificate and police verification before engagement
  • For PwBD candidates in Western Region-II, reservation/relaxation is subject to submission of a medical certificate for permanent disability, and only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the PwBD benefit

Documents Required for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment

  • Apprenticeship registration/enrolment number under NAPS/NATS with 100% completed profile
  • Scanned educational certificates and marksheets
  • Proof of age (Matriculation Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Passport, etc.)
  • SC/ST/latest OBC(NCL) caste certificate, if applicable
  • Bank cancelled cheque or first page of passbook (DBT-enabled account)
  • Recent colour passport-size photograph and signature
  • Disability certificate/UDID card in the prescribed format, if applicable (Unique Disability ID required for Western Region-I)

How to Apply for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Register as a candidate/student on NAPS (for ITI-Electrician) at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, or on NATS (for Degree/Diploma in Engineering/Civil) at nats.education.gov.in, and complete/update the profile with all required documents
  2. After obtaining the NAPS/NATS registration/enrolment number, visit www.powergrid.in
  3. Go to Careers → Engagement of Apprentices → Apply Online
  4. Select the region/state you wish to apply for (only one region/state is allowed)
  5. Fill in the online application with the required details and upload documents
  6. Submit the application before the last date, 10.09.2026

Applications must be submitted online through the official POWERGRID website only; no other mode of application is accepted, in any region.

POWERGRID Apprentice Important Instructions

  • Candidates should apply for only one region/state of their choice, out of all 10 regions
  • Candidates submitting multiple applications, or applying for more than one region/state/trade, will not be considered and their applications will be summarily rejected
  • The Name and Date of Birth on the application must match the Matriculation Certificate, Aadhaar Card, and bank account records
  • Candidates found ineligible, or providing false information, may be disqualified at any stage of the engagement process or during the engagement period
  • Completion of the apprenticeship does not entitle the apprentice to any claim for employment with POWERGRID
  • Training location will be decided as per facility availability and may be changed during the apprenticeship, including for job rotation, within the notified state
  • Shared bachelor accommodation may be provided subject to availability
  • Apprentices must maintain a weekly work diary and adhere to POWERGRID's code of conduct
  • POWERGRID reserves the right to terminate the apprenticeship for absenteeism, indiscipline, misconduct, poor performance, or policy violation

The South Indian Bank Ltd. (SIB), a premier Scheduled Commercial Bank in India with its registered office in Thrissur, Kerala, has invited online applications from Indian Nationals for the post of Junior Officer / Business Promotion Officer (BPO), a target-based sales role. Online registration opened on 19 August 2026 and closes on 31 August 2026. There is no application fee, and eligible candidates must apply only through the Bank's official website, www.southindianbank.bank.in.

The Bank has specifically cautioned applicants to beware of fraudulent job alerts: applications are accepted only through the official online portal, and all recruitment-related communication will be sent exclusively through the applicant's registered email address.

Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicant to be called for the recruitment process. The Bank reserves the right to modify the selection process depending on the number of applications received, and to decide how many applicants are called forward at each stage. In all matters relating to eligibility and selection, the Bank's decision is final, and no further correspondence will be entertained.

How to Apply for SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 - SIB Apply Online

Applicants can apply online through the Bank's website, www.southindianbank.bank.in, only between 19.08.2026 and 31.08.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Ensure you fulfil all the eligibility criteria before starting the application.
  2. Ensure the information provided in the online application form is correct before final submission - there is no provision to modify a submitted application.
  3. Ensure access to your registered email ID and contact number, and check them regularly, since all communication and updates are sent through these registered details only.
  4. Do not submit multiple registrations for the same role - applicants making multiple registrations will be disqualified.
  5. Enter your basic details and upload your photograph, signature and resume as per the specifications below.
  6. Note down the system-generated User ID (Application Reference ID) carefully for future reference; a confirmation email with registration details will be sent to your registered email ID.
  7. On successful submission, an email containing the application PDF and login credentials will be sent to your registered email ID.
  8. Confirm that your application has been submitted successfully by logging in to your profile - only successfully submitted applications will be considered.
  9. Keep a copy of the application for future reference. The physical copy of the application does not need to be sent to the Bank.

  • Applicants must fulfil all eligibility criteria (age, qualification, experience) at the time of applying; if any information furnished is later found false, the selection/appointment is liable to be terminated.
  • Upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years only for SC/ST candidates, who must submit attested certificates from a competent authority when called for.
  • Applicants should retain two copies of the photograph used in the application, for use during the recruitment process.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Applicants must appear for the recruitment process at their own cost.
  • Only applicants willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Appointment is subject to medical fitness and satisfactory background verification, including credit history/CIBIL check and police clearance, along with completion of other formalities as per Bank rules.
  • Shortlisting is provisional and without verification of original documents; candidature is subject to verification of all details/documents against originals at the time of interview/training/joining.

  • By submitting the application, the applicant consents to the collection, processing, storage, use and disclosure of their personal information and documents for purposes connected with the recruitment process and related administrative, legal and regulatory requirements, as detailed in the official notification.

Civil Engineer / Architect (Scale-I) Graduate in B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering, or Bachelor's Degree in Architecture, min. 60% marks 1 year in construction, maintenance, or project management in Bank/NBFC/FI/Fintech (desirable)
Manager-Credit (Scale-II) Full-time Graduate/Postgraduate degree in MBA (Finance). CA/CMA/CFA an added advantage Min. 3 years in Credit Department/handling credit portfolio in Bank/NBFC/FI/Fintech (mandatory)
Manager-Law (Scale-II) Full-time Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB), enrolled as advocate with Bar Council. PG Law degree preferred Min. 3 years as Law Officer in Bank/NBFC/FI/Fintech (mandatory)
Manager-Risk (Scale-II) Full-time Graduate/Postgraduate in MBA (Finance)/Master's in Mathematics/Statistics/Econometrics. Preference for risk-related certifications Min. 3 years as Risk Officer in Bank/NBFC/FI, working in Bank/FI/NBFC/Fintech units (mandatory)
Manager-Company Secretary (Scale-II) Associate Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI). LLB/CA/ICWA/CMA/FRM desirable Min. 3 years working as CS in Bank/NBFC/FI/Fintech (mandatory)
Manager-Security Officer (Scale-II) Bachelor's degree in any discipline Min. 5 years as Officer in Indian Army/Navy/Air Force not below rank of Captain, OR min. 5 years as Officer in Paramilitary not below rank of Deputy Commandant
Senior Manager-Treasury (Scale-III) Full-time Graduate in any discipline + PG in MBA/PGDBA/PGDBM/PGPM/PGDM with Finance specialization (min. 2 years duration), OR Master's in Statistics/Economics Min. 5 years in executing trades, managing asset-liability, interest rate risk, funding & liquidity in Bank/NBFC/FI/Fintech (mandatory)
Senior Manager-Forex (Scale-III) Full-time Graduate + MBA/PGDBA/PGDBM/PGPM/PGDM with specialization in Finance/International Business/Trade Finance (min. 2 years duration) Min. 5 years knowledge of currency markets, cross-currency swaps, forwards, trade finance, FEMA/FEDAI guidelines in Bank/NBFC/FI/Fintech (mandatory)
Senior Manager-Credit (Scale-III) Full-time Graduate + PG Degree in Finance. CA/CMA/CS/ICWA/CFA desirable Min. 5 years in credit-related operations/handling credit portfolio in Bank/NBFC/FI/Fintech (mandatory)
Senior Manager-Law (Scale-III) Full-time Bachelor's degree in Law, enrolled as Advocate with Bar Council. Master's degree preferred Min. 5 years working as Law Officer in Bank/NBFC/FI/Fintech (mandatory)

Where a university has awarded a CGPA/GPA and no percentage conversion criterion is specified, the percentage shall be calculated by dividing the total marks obtained by the candidate in all subjects across all semesters by the aggregate maximum marks in all subjects, irrespective of honours/optional/additional subjects. In case of experience, the relevant experience certificate must specifically mention experience in Banks/NBFCs/FIs/Fintech.

  • Grade/Scale-III posts (Senior Manager-Credit, Forex, Treasury, Law): 25 to 38 years

Bank transaction charges for online payment of the application fee will have to be borne by the candidate. The application fee is non-refundable and will not be refunded even if the application is rejected or not considered by the Bank.

Indemnity Bond

On selection, candidates must execute an Indemnity Bond with two sureties before joining as an Officer. For all cadres (Grade/Scale I, II & III), the bond amount is Rs. 3.00 Lakhs for a bond period of 2 years. If a candidate resigns, leaves, or abandons service before completing the specified period, they must indemnify the Bank for the bond costs, charges, and expenses incurred.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection is based on an Online Written Test followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates who qualify in the online written test will be called for interview, and final selection will be based on performance in both the written test and interview, subject to the candidate being found medically fit for the assignment.

  • The test is conducted only in English.
  • Each question has 5 answer options.
  • Penalty for wrong answer: Yes, 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer.

How to Apply for Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only from 15 August 2026 to 7 September 2026; no other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Go to the "Career" section of the Bank's website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in, click "Current Openings" under the Recruitment tab, and click "Apply Online".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note down the system-generated Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent by Email/SMS).
  3. Use the "Save and Next" facility to fill the form in stages if required, and verify details carefully before final submission.
  4. Upload your scanned Photograph and Signature as per the specifications given in the notification (Photograph: 4.5cm × 3.5cm, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB; Signature: 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB).
  5. Upload your scanned Left Thumb Impression (240×240 pixels, 200 DPI, 20–50 KB) and a handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 200 DPI, 50–100 KB) - text: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  6. Fill in all remaining details of the application form and click the Preview tab to verify the entire form before Complete Registration.
  7. Click "Complete Registration" only after confirming that the photograph, signature, and all details are correct, since no changes are possible thereafter.
  8. Click the "Payment" tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1,500 (including GST) through the available online payment modes.
  9. Click "Submit" and take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

All particulars mentioned in the online application - Name, Category, Date of Birth, Address, Mobile Number, Email ID, Centre of Examination, etc. - are considered final; no change or modification is allowed after submission.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Important Instructions

  • Signature and the handwritten declaration must be in the candidate's own handwriting and in English only; signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.
  • Photograph must be a recent passport-style colour picture against a light/white background, without caps, hats, or dark glasses (religious headwear allowed if it does not cover the face).
  • Candidates must produce, in original, a currently valid photo ID proof (PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving License, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar, Employee ID, Bar Council ID, etc.) along with a photocopy at the examination and interview. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are NOT valid ID proof.
  • The name on the call letter must exactly match the name on the photo ID proof; candidates who have changed their name (e.g., after marriage) must carry the original Gazette notification/marriage certificate/affidavit.
  • Candidates found with an unclear/blurred photo or signature in capital letters on the admit card will not be allowed to appear for the exam.
  • Mobile phones or similar electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited in the examination/interview hall.
  • A candidate is allowed to appear only once in the online examination for a post; multiple appearances will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Guidelines for scribe/compensatory time are provided for visually impaired candidates and candidates with locomotor disability/cerebral palsy or other specified disabilities under the RPWD Act, 2016, with prescribed certificates (Appendix-I) and undertakings (Appendix-II) as detailed in the official notification.
  • The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and will not be held in reserve for any future examination or selection.

SBI SCO Exam Day: Important Instructions

  • Reach the exam centre well before the reporting time mentioned on the admit card; late entry is generally not allowed once the gate closes.
  • Carry the admit card and a valid original photo ID entry may be denied without both.
  • No electronic devices, including mobile phones, smartwatches, or calculators, are permitted inside the exam hall.
  • Follow the specific stationery and dress code instructions printed on your admit card, if any.
  • SBI does not allow changes to the exam centre, date, or shift once the admit card is issued.
  • Keep the admit card safe after the exam, as it may be required again at the interview stage.

SBI SCO Selection Process 2026

Selection for the Assistant Manager (Law) and Deputy Manager (Law) posts is based on a written examination followed by an interview. The written exam includes objective and descriptive components; candidates need to clear the qualifying marks set for each section to move ahead in the process. Shortlisted candidates from the written exam are then called for a personal interview.

IOB Security Guard Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Candidate must be an Ex-Servicemen/Ex-Agniveer from the Army, Navy, or Air Force, as per the eligibility definitions in this notification.

  • Nationality: Citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee (pre-1962), or a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with the intention of permanently settling in India, subject to conditions.
Important: Persons with Disabilities (PWDs), Disabled Ex-Servicemen (disabled during operation or otherwise), and Dependants of Servicemen killed in action are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply for this recruitment.

Gandevi Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility is assessed as on 10 August 2026. Candidates must be domiciled in Gujarat State and must produce relevant original documents (with a photocopy) in support of their identity and eligibility, as and when called for. No change in the category, age, educational qualification, or other details provided during online registration will be permitted at any stage after submission of the application.

Educational Qualification

The minimum qualification for recruitment to the Clerical cadre is a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university with at least 55% marks. However:

  • Candidates holding a Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) degree are not eligible.
  • Candidates holding degrees in Engineering are also not eligible, except those holding a degree in Information Technology or Computer Science (BE/B.Tech or equivalent).
  • Candidates who have passed CA Intermediate or CMA Intermediate are also eligible.

All educational qualifications must be from a recognised University/Institution, with the result declared on or before 10 August 2026 (proper documentary proof of the result declaration date must be submitted at the time of interview). The date of passing the qualifying examination will be reckoned as the date of passing appearing on the mark sheet/provisional certificate. Candidates should also have knowledge of Gujarati, English, and Computers.

Gandevi Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection consists of an Online Written Examination followed by a Personal Interview. A candidate must qualify in both the Online Examination and the Interview to be considered for the subsequent recruitment process.

All test papers will be available only in English. The Bank reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination, which will be intimated through its website. A penalty of 1/4th of the marks assigned to a question is applied for each wrong answer (negative marking). Test-wise and total scores are reported with decimal points up to two digits, and scores may be equated across sessions to adjust for minor differences in difficulty level.

Examination Centres

The examination will tentatively be conducted in online mode at Surat, Vapi, and Vadodara. No request for change of examination centre will be entertained. The Bank reserves the right to cancel any examination centre, add other centres, or allot a candidate to a centre other than the one opted for, at its discretion. Candidates will appear for the examination at their own risk and expense.

Interview

Candidates shortlisted in the online examination will be called for a Personal Interview, to be conducted at Gandevi only. The centre, venue address, date, and time of the interview will be communicated through the interview call letter, downloadable from the Bank's website. Any request for a change in date/centre of the interview will not be entertained, though the Bank reserves the right to change these at its discretion under unforeseen circumstances.

PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Photo identity proof issued by a Gazetted Officer on official letterhead, Photo identity proof issued by a People's Representative on official letterhead, valid recent Identity Card issued by a recognised College/University, Aadhaar Card/E-Aadhaar Card with a photograph, Employee ID, or Bar Council Identity Card with photograph. Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not valid ID proofs for this recruitment. The candidate's name on the call letter must exactly match the name on the photo identity proof; candidates who have changed their name (e.g., after marriage) must produce a Gazette notification, marriage certificate, or affidavit as proof.

How to Apply for Gandevi Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only, through the Bank's official website www.gpcb.bank.in. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Before You Begin: Documents to Keep Ready

  • Scanned photograph (200 x 230 pixels preferred, 20–50 KB, recent colour passport-size, light background)
  • Scanned signature in black ink, not in capital letters (140 x 60 pixels preferred, 10–20 KB)
  • Scanned left thumb impression on white paper in black or blue ink (240 x 240 pixels at 200 DPI, i.e. 3 cm x 3 cm; 20–50 KB; JPG/JPEG format)
  • Scanned hand-written declaration in English, not in capital letters, in the candidate's own handwriting (800 x 400 pixels at 200 DPI, i.e. 10 cm x 5 cm; 50–100 KB; JPG/JPEG format). The declaration text is: "I ___________ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • A valid personal email ID and mobile number, to be kept active until the recruitment process is completed

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Visit www.gpcb.bank.in and click on "APPLY ONLINE".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and also sent by email/SMS – note these down.
  3. Use the "SAVE AND NEXT" option to fill the form in stages if needed, and verify all details carefully, as no change will be possible after clicking "Complete Registration".
  4. Upload your photograph and signature as per the specifications above.
  5. Fill in the remaining details of the application form.
  6. Use the Preview tab to check the entire form before final submission.
  7. Click "Complete Registration" only after verifying that the photograph, signature, and all other details are correct.
  8. Click "Payment" and complete the online fee payment.
  9. Click "Submit" to complete your application.
  10. Take a printout of the system-generated online application form and the e-Receipt for the fee payment, for your records.

All particulars submitted in the online application will be treated as final; no change or modification is allowed after submission. Not more than one application should be submitted by any candidate; in case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained, and the fee paid for other registrations will be forfeited.

Important Instructions

  • Merely applying, appearing, and being shortlisted in the examination and/or interview does not imply that a candidate will necessarily be offered employment; the Bank is not liable to assign any reason for rejecting a candidate.
  • A candidate's admission to the examination, shortlisting for interview, and subsequent processes are strictly provisional. If it is found at any stage that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms or has furnished incorrect/false information, the candidature will be rejected; if detected after appointment, services are liable to be summarily terminated.
  • Candidates should not carry mobile phones, pagers, calculators, or similar communication/electronic devices into the examination premises; the Bank cannot assure safekeeping of such items, and any infringement will lead to cancellation of candidature and possible debarment from future examinations.
  • Use of unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour in the exam/interview hall, or disclosure/transmission of test content can lead to disqualification, debarment from future Bank examinations, criminal prosecution, or termination of service if already appointed.
  • Online applications, once registered, cannot be withdrawn, and the application fee once paid will not be refunded or held in reserve for any other examination.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being declared medically fit and to the Bank's service and conduct rules.
  • No hard copy of the call letter or Information Handout will be sent by post or courier; candidates must download these from the Bank's website using their Registration Number and Password/Date of Birth.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification of the candidate.
  • Any dispute arising out of this advertisement or the recruitment process is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Gandevi.
  • In case of any dispute arising from interpretation of a version of this advertisement other than English, the English version available on the Bank's website will prevail.
  • All further announcements and details relating to this recruitment process will be published only on the Bank's authorised website, www.gpcb.bank.in.

SBI SCO Trade Finance Officer Qualification

Mandatory (both posts): Graduate (any discipline) from a Government-recognized University or Institution, and Certification in Forex Operations from IIBF. The certificate must be dated on or before 31.07.2026.

Preferred: Certificate for Documentary Credit Specialists (CDCS) by LIBF, or Certificate for Specialists in Demand Guarantees (CSDG) by LIBF, or Certified Trade Finance Professional (CTFP) by ICC Academy - OR - Global Trade Certificate (GTC) by ICC Academy, Certificate in International Trade Finance (CITF) by LIBF, or Certificate in International Trade Finance (IIBF). These preferred certificates should also be dated on or before 31.07.2026.

Job Profile

JMGS-I (Maker role): Inputs trade transactions and uploads documents into banking systems, handles TI+ data entry, conducts document scrutiny before approval, and inputs screening data into relevant systems.

MMGS-II (Checker role): Conducts TI+ checking to validate transactions, performs document scrutiny, facilitates screening against sanctions and AML policies, validates regulatory compliance, and acts as an OFAC releaser.

Selection for the Trade Finance Officer - IBG post will be made on the basis of Shortlisting and Interview.

RRB Group D Application Status: Categories Explained

Candidates can now view their updated status under three categories:

  • Provisionally Accepted: The application has been accepted on a provisional basis. It is not a final confirmation, and RRB can still cancel the candidature at any later stage if any discrepancy is found.
  • Conditionally Accepted: The application has been accepted subject to certain conditions. Candidates must check the specific conditions mentioned against their application and follow RRB's instructions.
  • Rejected: The application has been rejected, and the reason for rejection will be shown along with the status.

How to Check RRB Group D Application Status 2026

  1. Visit the official RRB application portal: www.rrbapply.gov.in.
  2. Log in using your registered user credentials.
  3. Navigate to the application status section for CEN No. 09/2025.
  4. View your status: Provisionally Accepted, Conditionally Accepted, or Rejected.
  5. If rejected, check the reason for rejection displayed against your application.
  6. Save or take a screenshot of the status page for future reference.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • The list of provisionally eligible candidates has been prepared carefully, but RRB reserves the right to rectify any inadvertent error or typographical/printing mistake.
  • RRB will not entertain any correspondence from ineligible or rejected candidates.
  • Candidature of all eligible/accepted candidates is purely provisional and can be cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process or even afterward if any inconsistency, deficiency, falsified record, or malpractice is found.
  • Candidates should refer only to official RRB websites for recruitment updates and must not rely on unauthenticated sources.
  • RRB has warned candidates to stay alert against touts who make false promises of selection in exchange for illegal consideration. The RRB recruitment process is fully computerized, and selection is based purely on merit.

If your application shows as provisionally or conditionally accepted, continue preparing for the next stage of the CEN 09/2025 recruitment process as and when RRB announces it. The cut-off is not a fixed number decided in advance it depends on several exam and recruitment factors, which is why it differs across zones and categories:

WBCS Exam Pattern 2026 (Preliminary)

The WBCS Preliminary Examination is conducted offline in OMR-based format and is used only to screen candidates for the Mains exam; marks scored in Prelims are not counted toward the final merit list.

  • Mode: Offline (OMR-based)
  • Question type: Objective (MCQ)
  • Total questions: 200
  • Subjects covered: 8 core subjects
  • Marks per section: 25 marks
  • Duration: 2.5 hours (12:00 PM to 2:30 PM)

How to Download WBCS Final Answer Key 2026

  1. Visit the official WBPSC website: psc.wb.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "What's New" or "Answer Key" section on the homepage.
  3. Look for the notification titled "Final Answer Keys to the MCQ Paper of the W.B.C.S. (Exe) etc. (Preli) Examination, 2024" (Memo No. 1104-PSC/CON(Q), dated 27 August 2026).
  4. The Final Answer Key PDF will open on the screen.
  5. Download and save the PDF to your device.
  6. Match your marked OMR responses against the final official answers.
  7. Calculate your probable score using the marking scheme mentioned in the official notification. Note: as per the official key, one mark is awarded for each question marked with an asterisk (*), irrespective of the option a candidate attempted.

How to Raise an Objection Against the WBCS Answer Key 2026

WBPSC allowed candidates to challenge any answer they believed was incorrect during the objection window (30 June 2026 to 6 July 2026). The exact online objection portal link, format for supporting evidence, and fee (if any) per objection are Not Available Officially in the sources reviewed for this article candidates should refer to the detailed instructions in the official answer key notification PDF on psc.wb.gov.in.

What Happens After the WBCS Final Answer Key 2026?

  • Objection Review (completed): WBPSC reviewed the objections submitted between 30 June and 6 July 2026.
  • Final Answer Key (released): Published on 27 August 2026, incorporating the Commission's review of objections.
  • WBCS Prelims Result 2026: To be prepared and declared based on this Final Answer Key. Date: Not Yet Announced.
  • WBCS Mains 2026: Candidates who qualify in the Prelims will be shortlisted for the Mains examination.

Important Instructions

  • The WBCS Preliminary Examination is only a screening stage marks obtained in Prelims are not added to the final merit list.
  • Always cross-check any downloaded answer key PDF against the official WBPSC portal to avoid relying on unofficial or lookalike websites.
  • Keep your roll number and admit card details handy when checking the result once declared.
  • Only the final answer key (after objections are resolved) is used to prepare the official result.

KEA Kannada Language Test 2026 What It Is

The Compulsory Kannada Language Test is a qualifying test, not a merit-ranking exam. It applies only to candidates from the outside-Karnataka and Kalyana-Karnataka quota who have not studied or passed their qualifying examination in Kannada, or who have not cleared an equivalent Kannada test, or who have not completed SSLC-level schooling with Kannada as a first or second language. Clearing this test alone does not guarantee final selection it is a mandatory clearance step for the candidates it applies to. The 22nd August 2026 sitting covered candidates applying for the following posts:

  • Police Department CAR/DAR/KSRP/IRB/KSISF Constable posts
  • Revenue Department Village Administrative Officer (VAO)

  4. The answer key will display version-wise A1, B1, C1, and D1 on the screen.
  5. Match the answers against your version code and marked responses.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference and for use during objection filing.

KEA Kannada Language Test 2026 Objection Process

Candidates who wish to challenge any answer in the provisional key can do so through the official KEA Provisional Answer Key Objection Portal. The window is open from 22nd August 2026 until 24th August 2026, 12:00 noon, after which no objections will be accepted.

Steps to Raise an Objection

  1. Visit the objection portal login page at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/keaobjections.
  2. Log in using your Application Number/Register Number and the first 5 characters of your name.
  3. Enter your Date of Birth.
  4. Select the examination Compulsory Kannada – 2026 (22-08-2026).
  5. Enter the captcha code and log in.
  6. Select the question number and version code you want to object to.
  7. Upload supporting documents or proof in PDF format for each objection.
  8. Pay the applicable fee of Rs. 25/- per objection and submit.

Important Instructions

  • Every objection must clearly mention the question number and version code, and must be supported by valid proof in PDF format.
  • A fee of Rs. 25/- is charged per objection raised; this fee is non-refundable.
  • Objections that do not correctly mention the question number or version code, or that lack valid supporting proof, will not be considered.
  • The decision of the subject expert committee reviewing the objections will be treated as final.
  • Objections cannot be submitted after 24th August 2026, 12:00 noon.

Also Read: HTET Result 2026

What Happens After the Objection Window Closes

Once the objection window closes on 24th August 2026, the subject expert committee will review all objections submitted by candidates. Based on this review, KEA will release the final answer key for the Kannada Language Test. Results will then be prepared using the final key, feeding into the overall selection process for the respective posts Police Constable, Village Administrative Officer, Land Surveyor, KREIS Teacher, and Section Officer. The exact date for the final key and result has not been officially announced yet.

RSSB Final Answer Key 2026: What It Means

A final answer key is the last, legally binding version of the answer key. RSSB releases it only after reviewing every objection candidates raised against the earlier provisional answer key. Once the final answer key is published, no further objections are accepted, and the board prepares the result strictly on the basis of this document.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.

  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026 - Download Link, Scorecard, and Marking Scheme

The Staff Selection Commission released the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026 on 17th June 2026, along with individual scorecards and response sheets for the Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025-26. Candidates who appeared in the Tier 2 exam, held on 18th and 19th January 2026, can now log in at ssc.gov.in using their Registration ID and password to download their final answer key, marks, and response sheet. The facility is available until 16th July 2026 (9:00 PM), after which the documents will no longer be accessible.

This release comes more than two months after SSC declared the Tier 2 final result on 8th April 2026, where 15,118 candidates were provisionally selected for various Group B and Group C posts. The final answer key now gives every candidate, selected or not, a way to verify exactly how their score was calculated.

Click Here: SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

What Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section explains what the final answer key actually is and how it differs from the result already announced earlier this year. The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

How to Download SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section walks you through the exact login process to access your final answer key, scorecard, and response sheet from the official SSC portal.

The download process requires your individual login credentials rather than a single public link, since the answer key and scorecard are personalized to each candidate's response sheet. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Look for the notification related to the Tier 2 scorecard and final answer key for CGL 2025-26.
  3. Click on the candidate login link provided in the notification.
  4. Enter your Registration ID and Password to log in.
  5. Your scorecard, final answer key, and response sheet will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and save the PDF files for future reference before the access window closes.

Since this is a login-gated system tied to individual candidate records, there is no generic public download link that works for all candidates; each person must sign in with their own registered credentials.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Paper Correct Answer Wrong Answer
Paper 1 (Sections I, II & Computer Module I) +3 marks -1 mark
Paper 2 (Statistics) +2 marks -0.50 marks

Unattempted questions carry zero marks under both papers, so there is no penalty for skipping a question you were unsure about. Paper 2 was applicable only to candidates who applied for Junior Statistical Officer and Statistical Investigator Grade II posts.

Timeline: From Provisional Key to Final Answer Key

This section traces the complete sequence of events from the Tier 2 exam to the release of the final answer key, helping candidates understand how each stage led to the next.

  • The Tier 2 exam was conducted on 18th and 19th January 2026.
  • The provisional answer key was released on 30th January 2026, with an objection window open until 3rd February 2026 (8:00 PM).
  • SSC reviewed all valid objections submitted against the provisional key.
  • The Tier 2 final result and merit list were declared on 8th April 2026, with 15,118 candidates provisionally selected.
  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026 Marking Scheme - How to Calculate Your Score

Candidates can estimate their scores using the official marking scheme prescribed by SSC. For every correct answer, 2 marks are awarded. For every incorrect answer, 0.25 marks are deducted. Unattempted questions carry zero marks.

Response Type Marks

Score Calculation Formula:
Total Score = (No. of Correct Answers × 2) − (No. of Wrong Answers × 0.25)

The role focuses on handling homeowner enquiries and acquiring interior designer partners, serving as the first point of contact for homeowners by responding promptly, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with suitable designers, while also cold-calling interior designers across Delhi NCR to onboard them as HeyBuddy partners. This is a high-volume calling role with an expectation of making 150 quality calls per day across both pipelines. There are no sales targets, revenue quotas, or closure requirements; the primary responsibility is to consistently maintain the required call volume and ensure high-quality interactions that contribute to successful conversions. Key Responsibilities: A. Homeowner enquiries: 1. Speed to lead. Call every enquiry from our website, Meta ads, and expos within minutes. The first credible call usually wins the project. 2. Qualify on the call. Location, possession status, scope, realistic budget, timeline- and disqualify politely when a lead isn't ready. A clean 'no' beats a padded pipeline. 3. Pitch with credibility, not pressure. Explain how interior projects are actually priced and executed, and why a HeyBuddy-verified designer beats a random reference. Sell by being useful, not loud. 4. Book the meeting. Your output is a confirmed designer introduction or site visit. 5. Work the follow-up cycle. Homeowners take 3–6 months to decide. Run disciplined call and WhatsApp sequences until a lead closes or dies. Most conversions happen on the fourth call, not the first. B. Designer partner acquisition: 1. Build your own list. Designers and firms across Noida, Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, and Delhi- sourced from Instagram, listings, referrals, and market research. 2. Pitch the partnership. Qualified leads, no upfront cost, pay only for introductions. Handle the repeat objections- 'we get enough leads,' 'what's your commission,' 'we tried a portal before.' 3. Screen before you sign. Qualify on portfolio, execution capability, team strength, ticket-size fit, and client feedback. Thirty good firms beat three hundred listed ones. 4. Close and onboard. Documentation, commission terms, platform onboarding- until they are live and receiving leads. C. Pipeline and loop-closing: 1. Log every dial, connect, disposition, and next action the same day. An untracked call didn't happen. 2. Nothing sits untouched beyond 72 hours. 3. Reconfirm every site visit the day before, and call after every meeting for feedback. 4. Report what homeowners and designers actually say- objections, pricing concerns, competitor mentions- straight to marketing, product, and the founders. What you're measured on: 1. Everything on this list is inside your control. 2. 150 calls a day. The one hard number. 3. Talk time. Calls ending in eleven seconds don't count for much. 4. Call quality. Reviewed from recordings- did you ask, listen, and advise honestly? 5. Follow-up adherence. Every open lead contacted on schedule. 6. CRM hygiene. Logged same day, every day. 7. Conversions, site visits, and partner activations are tracked- but they're the company's scoreboard, not a quota over your head. Who fits: 1. Fluent Hindi and working English. 2. Comfortable dialling all day- reads a room over the phone. 3. Writes a clean CRM note. 4. Prior experience in real estate, interiors, edtech, or any high-volume inside sales floor is an advantage, not a requirement.

Role Snapshot

You've been designing long enough to have watched tools become essential and then disappear. You know which design skills are timeless and which ones expire.Â The human-centered design skills are where your heart is, and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

You can name theÂ ten leading designersÂ who should be teaching the worldâs best courses and Master Classes right now. You know what each of them does better than anyone else, and where their gaps are.

Now you get the opportunity to decide what hundreds of thousands of designers learn next.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads atÂ Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You'll be involved in the entire process of creating our courses and Master Classes, and you'll lead many of the decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

We're a flexible team, and you'll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Director, decide what belongs in our curriculum and who should teach it. You reach out to the worldâs leading experts, plan the courses with them, and shoot courses with them. When an Education Designer brings you a course outline, you're the one who says what's missing, what doesn't belong, and how to optimize the learning outcome so designers can succeed today. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, yourÂ Team Lead, our otherÂ Course Directors, and theÂ Education Designers, and you'll plan and create courses alongside them. Our Course Writers and Editors take the finished material the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

  • You'll research what already exists in a topic area, so that what we build is genuinely unique. You'll look atÂ where design and AI are heading, what designers needÂ that nobody has taught well yet, andÂ what we should retireÂ because the field has already moved on.

  • Find the people who should teach it.Â You decide a topic is worth a course, you work out who should teach it and why, you write the email, and you get the yes. Then you plan the content with the industry leader and agree what the course must leave a learner able to do.

  • Decide what each expert should teach.Â The best designers know a great deal, and a course that tries to capture all of it becomes an information dump. You develop a point of view on what a designer genuinely needs from them, and you hold the course to it.

  • You'll decide which skills our courses teach, both to people entering design and to experienced designers leveling up. Our goal is to help designers thrive in the age of AI and work responsibly, so their users can thrive too.

  • Ensure our course participants finish each course with a solid portfolio project they can show a hiring manager.

  • Help us decide what AI should do for our course participants. Personalized learning paths, constructive AI feedback on portfolio work, practice environments where people run real design tasks and get feedback. You'll also help us improve the user flows on our own platform, so that learning at IxDF is as well designed as what we teach. You'll work on this with our founders, designers, and dev team.

  • Make an impact as you pressure-test the coursesÂ our Education Designers plan. An Education Designer sends you a course outline, and you read it against everything you know about the field and about how people learn design, then give constructive feedback on what's missing, what doesn't belong, and where the structure can be improved.Â You know the limits of your own expertise, and you research your way past them before you weigh in. You'll also plan, structure, and create courses yourself, alongside them.

  • You're one of the peopleÂ whose judgment the rest of the team leans on.Â You show our Education Designers what ten or twenty years in the field taught you to look for. In return, our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, and our other Course Directors give constructive feedback on the courses you lead. You'll work in aÂ diverse, highly organized, result-driven environmentÂ where you'll grow personally and professionally.

  • Act as guardian of our quality bar. When a course goes out under our name, it has to be better than anything else available on the topic. On the courses and Master Classes you lead or review, you're the one who spots what's not good enough yet and works with the team to fix it.

  • Bring your subject matter expertiseÂ to our writers, community managers, and social media team, so our design thinking stays consistent across everything we publish.

  • You help produce Master Classes. We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â Timelines vary enormously:Â with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Education Designers and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

  • Focus on what mattersÂ as you take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

  • Design for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, a course will serve both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

  • Give the video teamÂ constructive feedbackÂ on course and Master Class videos, from on-screen text and b-roll to graphics and animation, so each video is engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective.

  • Fly out and meet the global industry leaders in design in professional studios across the world.Â You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On averageÂ we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Expect to have several courses moving at once at different stages: one you're planning with an expert, one being shot, one in production, and one published course that you're reviewing and improving.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

  • Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • We're proud to have assembledÂ a remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

About You

  • You have at leastÂ 10 years of hands-on design experience. Thirty is not too many.

  • You have aÂ network among designers you respect, and you'reÂ comfortable writing to someone you admireÂ and presenting them with an opportunity.

  • You know what the design community wants to see, and what it needs to learn.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathy toÂ engage well with very different kinds of people. Much of this job is convincing busy, accomplished people that what we're building is worth their time.

  • You can show us something you built or led: a product, a design team, a course, an AI teaching app, or a conference track. We're excited to hear what it was, your thinking behind it, how long it took you to create, what went wrong, and how you improved it.

  • You can take aÂ broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequenceÂ that'll make a beginner feel and act confident. You can look at a plan for teaching something andÂ see what's missingÂ before anyone builds it.

  • You're aÂ practical idealist. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

  • You don't need a design background.Â Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.

  • Write for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.

  • Be the voice of IxDF.Â Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours.Â Represent a global movement dedicated to design education, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.

  • Set and raise the standard for our assessments, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.

  • Balance the big picture with the smaller details.Â Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.

  • Turn expert material into lessons.Â Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.

  • Our coursesÂ combine written and video lessons.Â You'll work closely with the video team, givingÂ constructive feedbackÂ on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios learners produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Small, incremental edits are why our material surpasses even the very best in industry and academia.Â We're always learning, always improving, always raising the barÂ in everything we do.

  • Weâre committed toâ¯excellence, and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role isâ¯not for the average. Ahead of you is aâ¯highly rewarding and enriching journey.

  • Maintain and improve ourÂ crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • You won't do this alone.Â You'll work with our Education Designers, Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the material: you'll add what's missing, delete what's redundant, and suggest how to improve the structure. You'll be working with people who have anything from 4 to 40 years of design experience, ready to share their knowledge. We'll also help you upskill so you can grow a designer's eye alongside your editor's ear. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll developÂ personally and professionally.

  • We're proud to have assembled aÂ remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

Do You Share IxDF's Vision?

People don't just buy our courses; they invest in a better version of themselves and a career they truly love. That's why every course we create and every sentence we write must do more than just inform. It must reflect the high-quality research and hands-on skills we teach.

  • Show the dream outcome: Help people imagine a future of creative, meaningful work, fulfillment, and impact through a career in design and AI.

  • Strengthen belief in success: Build confidence through real stories, practical case studies, and hands-on templates.

  • Overcome barriers: Write in a way that's crystal clear, human, and motivating. Connect and lead the way.

You'll educate, inspire, energize, and support. Whether you write a course article or give editorial feedback on a video, you'll help designers thrive in the age of AI.

About You

  • You have at least 4 years of professional writing or editing experience.

  • What matters far more than the number is the quality of the work you can show us: a course, an article series, a set of scripts, documentation, a newsletter. Weâre excited to hear what it was, why you wrote it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

  • You're aÂ master communicatorÂ with aÂ sharp eye for detailÂ andÂ strong skills in language, tone, and flow.

  • You can take a complex idea and write it so a beginner gets it on the first read.

  • You know how to hook someone with a title and a first line, and you know the difference betweenÂ a hook that's earnedÂ and a hook that's cheap.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to write, research, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, soÂ the outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • Youâre eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You can write for a career changer and for an experienced designer without losing either one.

  • You have anÂ exceptional talent for creating structure, and you take pride in organizing processes and tasks in a way that's efficient and clear.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about UX and UI design, and you're motivated to learn how great design shapes experiences and solves problems.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathyÂ to engage well with very different kinds of people.

  • You're fluent in written and spoken English, your grammar is exact, and you understand the power of tone, brevity, and microcopy.

  • You takeÂ full ownershipÂ of your work and see it through. You move comfortably across ad hoc projects of varying complexity, and you stay consistent when the work turns repetitive.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

  • You work well with great responsibility and freedom inside a well-documented, structured system. Accuracy and attention to detail are key on an online learning platform, where every tag must be correct and every piece of text formatted to our upload system. It's in your nature to meticulously double-check that everything is in order.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC+0 (London) and UTC+4 (Dubai), which covers Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Bonus Points

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ taught in classrooms or workshops, orÂ you've created educational material.

  • You have yourÂ own blog or social media pageÂ where you create and share original content.

  • You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ degree in communications, journalism, literature, or a similar field.

What We Can Offer

  • Reach and impactÂ that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. Your words will be read year after year, by hundreds of thousands of people who build better careers and design a better world for all of us.Â An education you can't buy:Â free access to every IxDF course and Master Class, and a job that requires you to study the work of the best designers alive in order to edit it. Most people pay for this. You'll be paid for it.

  • Access:Â the designers whose books you'd normally buy are the people whose words you'll be shaping, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with.

  • Studio shoots:Â once you know our courses well, usually after your first year, you'll be a real asset on a studio production, and you'll be welcome to join us when we meet our experts in professional studios around the world. Some of us love that part and go every time; others keep travel to a minimum. Both work for us. On average we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Autonomy:Â Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. You decide how our courses read.

  • A global, purpose-driven team: Work remotelyÂ alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by aÂ common missionÂ to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone.

  • Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

  • AÂ full-time positionÂ within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or a studio production.

  • Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessionsÂ and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

  • A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, orÂ corporate drama. Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

  • A daily mission to help impact,Â empower, and enrich the lives of millions of peopleÂ by creatingÂ affordable high-end design educationÂ for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

  • A companyÂ where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.Â We're a highly agile organization withÂ zero bureaucracy or corporate politicsÂ â and withÂ exceptional order and efficiency.

  • A company culture whereÂ passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process,Â you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

  • We thrive because we have aÂ hands-on attitude and a bias towards actionÂ as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll needÂ crisp execution skills yourselfÂ and the ability toÂ impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

  • If you want even more opportunities to show the world what you can do, youâre in luck! When you're willing to do the hard work of learning and growing, then youâll find virtuallyÂ limitless opportunities with us.

  • We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at theÂ forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it. You'll helpÂ set a direction that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.Â

Day-to-day of the role:
